jobs.title: Scientific Programmer
jobs.description:
This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys tackling undefined challenges, and is motivated to learn and innovate continuously.

In our small and dynamic software team, you'll have the opportunity to engage with all parts of the software stack, fostering a collaborative environment where diverse skills and ideas are valued.

You will be an integral part of our research and development team, by developing and maintaining our products and services for well logging applications. We have developed sensors that emit radar pulses and sample them after reflecting off the wellbore. The Scientific Programmer will assist with improving and developing our software and algorithms to transform the raw data to intuitive 3D visualizations. The key to develop the processing algorithms is understanding how our sensors behave and how the pulses propagate.

Example of tasks:

  • Mathematical modelling of signal pulses

  • Development of new data processing algorithms

  • Improvement of the user interfaces to existing software

  • Increasing the quality of the codebase

  • Improving the performance of the existing processing algorithms

Part of your work could also be in our lab where you will be testing and verifying your own and the team's new solutions and software.

The candidate we are looking for has:

  • Master's degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or similar fields with good academic results

  • Previous experience in, and theoretical knowledge of, digital signal processing

  • Competency in object-oriented programming, with particular focus on Python

  • Good mathematical abilities, preferably with a background in Physics

  • Understanding of the importance of type hinting, logging, exception handling and documentation during development


Experience with the following is beneficial and will be emphasized in the evaluation, so please mention if you have any knowledge or work experience of the following:

  • Mathematical modelling of physical systems

  • Multiprocessing and multithreading in Python

  • The HDF5 file format

  • The QT framework and the Python wrapper 'PyQT5'

  • The data visualization library 'PyQtGraph'

  • Version control with Git

  • Collaborative programming


Requirements:

You will need to be fluent in English, both written and verbal. Norwegian language skill is an advantage. Since the position could require some training in the USA, you must fulfill VISA requirements for travels to the USA.

What we offer you:

As an employee of WELL ID, you'll be at the forefront of developing cutting-edge products and services. You'll have ample opportunities to collaborate with customers and contractors, supported by our team through mentorship programs and continuous learning initiatives to help you succeed.

  • High tech Research and Development

  • Small organization where your effort is recognized

Office location in Greater Stavanger area.

jobs.title: Automotive Program & Cost Controller
jobs.description:
In this role, you will support the financial management and development of vehicle programs across key milestones and throughout the product lifecycle. As the financial controller for assigned model-year programs, you will partner closely with Program Management and cross-functional teams to provide financial transparency, enable informed decision-making, and support efficient program execution.

The position covers both program investments and vehicle profitability, combining strategic financial planning with hands-on business controlling. You will collaborate with stakeholders across functions such as Program Management, Research & Development, Manufacturing, Design, Procurement, Business Planning, Volume Planning, and Finance.

The role also involves close collaboration with external partners and manufacturing organizations responsible for providing development cost quotations, investment estimates, and production-related financial data.

You will contribute to key financial planning cycles, including forecasting, budgeting, and long-term business planning, covering investment expenditure, product costs, and vehicle profitability for your assigned programs.

In addition to program controlling, the position includes financial controlling responsibilities related to manufacturing plants, providing exposure to both program finance and product/manufacturing cost controlling.

Key Responsibilities

    

Manage and communicate the financial development of model-year programs against agreed targets, budgets, and milestones.

    

Act as a financial business partner to Program Management, providing reliable financial information, analysis, and decision support throughout the program lifecycle.

    

Serve as a key point of contact for program-related financial topics across Finance and operational functions.

    

Consolidate, analyse, and present investment, cost, and profitability information for key program milestones, including variance analysis and explanations of underlying business drivers.

    

Support decisions concerning capital expenditure (CAPEX), product profitability, and short- and long-term financial planning through analyses, business cases, and financial investigations.

    

Coordinate financial input from multiple functions to ensure accurate and consistent program planning, forecasting, and reporting.

    

Manage financial controlling activities related to manufacturing operations, ensuring robust reporting, analysis, and assessment of financial performance.

    

Analyse manufacturing and transfer-pricing structures in close cooperation with relevant finance and controlling stakeholders.

    

Develop and support business cases and financial investigations related to manufacturing operations, including Bill of Material (BOM) development, cost-improvement initiatives, and cost-reduction tracking.

    

Identify financial risks and opportunities and provide actionable insights to relevant stakeholders.

What Will Make You Successful

You have a strong analytical mindset and are comfortable working with complex financial and operational information. You can translate detailed data into clear business insights and communicate effectively with stakeholders from different functions and levels of the organization.

You enjoy working in a cross-functional and international environment and are comfortable balancing strategic financial planning with operational business support. You are structured, proactive, and able to coordinate inputs from multiple stakeholders while maintaining a clear view of deadlines, priorities, and financial targets.

Competence Requirements

    

3–10 years of experience in financial controlling or financial analyst roles.

    

Excellent analytical capabilities.

    

Strong Excel skills and experience handling data.

    

Experience in controlling, including setting targets and monitoring performance against them.

    

Strong project management skills, with the ability to act as a central point for coordinating and consolidating input from numerous internal stakeholders.

    

Understanding of potential cost and revenue drivers within the automotive industry.

Other Requirements

    

Self-motivated and driven, with a proactive approach to resolving issues and identifying potential improvements.

    

Excellent communication skills and the ability to interact effectively with multiple stakeholders.

    

A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.

From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future — and we want you to be part of it.

In this position, you will combine close and supportive leadership with a strong focus on safety, quality, delivery and continuous improvement. You will have direct responsibility for a team of process operators and technicians. You will also work closely with colleagues within quality, engineering, maintenance and logistics to ensure that the organization achieves its targets.

An important part of the role is to lead continuous improvement activities in line with HOS, the Husqvarna Operating System, and to ensure that the department meets our high standards for quality, delivery performance and operational efficiency.

Location

As a Production Supervisor, you will be a hands-on leader in our production environment, working closely with your team and the wider organization every day. Your physical presence on site is essential to ensure smooth operations, enable fast decision-making, foster collaboration and provide visible, supportive leadership.

We believe that being close to the operation and the people who make it happen creates the best conditions for learning, continuous improvement and great results. This role is based full time on site.

jobs.title: 1.assistent til SMP - Fyn
jobs.description:
Vi søger en erfaren 1.assistent til Fyn

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP Rengøringsservice er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team på Fyn.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP rengøringsservice. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

•   Skabe god relation til kunderne

•   Være behjælpelig med afløsning ved. ferie/sygdom

•   Hjælpe ved opstart af nye kunder og opgaver sammen med Serviceinspektør

•   Forefaldne opgaver i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

 

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

 

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

Som person kan du nikke genkendende til, at du:

•   Har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

•   Trives i en til tider hektisk hverdag

•   Står til rådighed for rengøring af egne pladser

•   deler telefonvagt efter forudgående aftale

     står for sidemandsoplæring af rengøringspersonale

•   Kan håndtere og omgås forskellige kulturer

•   Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale på et rimeligt niveau

•   Har kørekort

•   Kan fremvise straffeattest

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

Vi glæder os meget til at lære dig at kende - så hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, bedes du sende din ansøgning til: job@smpservice.dk  - husk at mærke ansøgningen ” 1.assistent Fyn”

 

Samtaler bliver holdt løbende.

 

Har du ikke hørt fra os inden den 04.10.2026, skal du betragte jobbet som besat til anden side.

 

SMP er en velrenommeret virksomhed i rengøringsbranchen, - og det vil vi gerne blive ved med at være

Vi beskæftiger i dag mere end 300 medarbejdere med kunder i en stor del af Danmark. Vi har landsdækkende og lokale aftaler inden for kontor, produktion, skoler, slagterier, bagerier, butikker, supermarkeder mv.

 

SMP har lokale afdelinger både på Fyn, Jylland og Sjælland

jobs.description:
Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme North Resort Oy:lle Pelloon Resort Manageria vastaamaan uuden resortin päivittäisestä toiminnasta ja liiketoiminnan kokonaisuudesta. Työsuhde on kokoaikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva, ja valittu henkilö työllistyy suoraan North Resort Oy:n palvelukseen.

North Resort Oy rakentaa Pellon Miekojärven rannalle uuden ympärivuotisen matkailuresortin, jossa yhdistyvät korkeatasoinen majoitus, laadukas ravintolatoiminta, henkilökohtainen palvelu ja aidot lappilaiset elämykset. Resortin toiminta käynnistyy marraskuussa 2026, ja ensimmäiset kansainväliset asiakkaat vastaanotetaan joulukuun alussa.

Tutustu yritykseen tarkemmin: https://www.northpremiumresort.com/

Resort Managerina

Työskentelet käytännönläheisessä johtotehtävässä, jossa yhdistyvät henkilöstön, asiakaskokemuksen, myynnin, talouden, turvallisuuden ja operatiivisen toiminnan johtaminen. Vastuualueeseesi kuuluvat:

* henkilöstön johtaminen, rekrytointi, perehdytys ja kehittäminen,
* asiakaskokemuksen ja palvelun laadun johtaminen,
* myynnin, käyttöasteen ja kaupallisen toiminnan kehittäminen,
* budjetointi, talouden seuranta ja kannattavuuden kehittäminen,
* varausjärjestelmien ja myyntikanavien kehittäminen sekä
* turvallisuuden, omavalvonnan ja vastuullisuuden varmistaminen.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä Sales Managerin sekä muiden avainhenkilöiden ja sidosryhmien, kuten matkailukumppaneiden ja viranomaisten kanssa. Toimit esihenkilönä resortin eri toimintojen päälliköille ja raportoit yhtiön johdolle ja hallitukselle.

Tehtävä edellyttää

* kokemusta matkailu-, hotelli-, ravintola- tai palveluliiketoiminnan johtamisesta,
* vahvaa kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja henkilöstöjohtamisesta,
* kaupallista ja taloudellista ymmärrystä,
* hyviä organisointi- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja,
* kykyä toimia itsenäisesti ja tehdä päätöksiä,
* kiinnostusta uuden liiketoiminnan rakentamiseen,
* sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen kirjallista ja suullista taitoa.

Parhaiten tehtävässä menestyy henkilö, jolla on aiempaa kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä, esimerkiksi Resort Managerina tai Hotel Managerina. Meille koulutusta tärkeämpää on näyttö onnistuneesta kokonaisuuksien johtamisesta. North Resortin tiimiin sopii parhaiten oma-aloitteinen, käytännönläheinen ja vastuunkantokykyinen johtaja, joka viihtyy kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä ja innostuu uuden rakentamisesta.

Vastineeksi osaamisestasi tarjoamme

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden päästä rakentamaan uutta, korkeatasoista matkailukohdetta sen ensimmäisistä vaiheista lähtien ja vaikuttamaan merkittävästi resortin toimintamalleihin, prosesseihin ja työyhteisöön. Työskentelet kansainvälisten asiakkaiden parissa ja pääset hyödyntämään osaamistasi uuden liiketoiminnan rakentamisessa. Tehtävän palkka on neuvoteltavissa huomioiden aiempi kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi. Tarvittaessa autamme myös asunnon järjestämisessä.

Mikäli kiinnostuit, jätä hakemuksesi pian nettisivuillamme olevan hakulomakkeen kautta tai kysy lisätietoja. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading the successful delivery of building automation projects across multiple datacenter construction sites. You will work closely with project teams, subcontractors, consultants, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule, and within budget.

This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in high-profile critical infrastructure projects within a growing and technically demanding industry.

The assignment starts ASAP and is expected to continue for approximately 12 months.

The successful candidate can be employed under a fixed-term employment contract or engaged through a contractor agreement, depending on their situation and preferences.

* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of building automation projects across multiple datacenter construction sites
* Manage project teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery
* Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, forecasts, and risk management plans
* Oversee project financials, including cost control, forecasting, reporting, and margin management
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations, quality standards, and project requirements
* Coordinate activities with consultants, contractors, and project stakeholders
* Oversee procurement, logistics, and resource allocation across multiple sites
* Monitor project performance and provide regular project reporting
* Support commissioning, handover, and project close-out activities

* 5+ years of project management experience within construction, building services, automation, or related industries

Experience managing large-scale projects, working in regulated environments, and proficiency with project management tools such as MS Project or Primavera will further support success in this role.

PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certifications, as well as a degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Automation, or a related field, are considered advantageous.

jobs.title: Business Controller, Kesko-IT
jobs.description:
Would you like to help build the IT steering of the future together with Finlands leading trade sector operator? We are looking for an experienced Business Controller to join K-IT to build the future of IT financial steering, cost transparency and support for management decision-making.

Your role

As a Business Controller, you will act as K-ITs finance partner and help ensure that decision-making is based on high-quality data and a solid business understanding. You will take an active part in budgeting, forecasting and reporting processes and support IT managements decision-making as a member of the K-IT management team. You will work with a broad network of stakeholders across K-IT and the business divisions, fostering a shared understanding of IT service costs, cost allocations, and the business value generated through technology investments

Your key responsibilities include:
- Analysing and reporting on Kesko Group IT costs - Coordinating budgeting and forecasting processes - Acting as a sparring partner for business and IT management on financial matters - Developing reporting, forecasting and analytics processes and tools - Driving the development of IT cost transparency through a TBM-based cost management model
To succeed in this role, we believe that you

Are an experienced Business Controller with the ability to grasp both the details and the bigger picture. You can challenge constructively and bring insights to support decision-making, but you also have the patience and accuracy to handle the necessary routines to a high standard.

We are looking for:
- several years of experience in Controller/Business Controller roles - experience in IT controlling or in monitoring IT costs - an understanding of cost allocations, service pricing or IT cost transparency solutions (experience of TBM-type models is considered an advantage) - the ability to combine data, business understanding and impactful communication - excellent collaboration and interpersonal skills - a development-oriented and proactive approach to work
In addition, we value:
- Anaplan skills - advanced Excel and reporting skills - knowledge of ServiceNow and related tools will be an advantage - fluency in Finnish and English - experience of financial steering in large organizations - a track record of using GenAI to develop both individual ways of working and/or finance processes
Why join us?

We offer you the opportunity to work in a front-row seat in one of Finlands largest IT organizations. You will be able to influence significant development initiatives, build new operating models and make use of modern technologies and GenAI as part of financial management.

At Kesko are working in a hybrid workplace model where we combine office days and remote work to best suit both the role and the team. The role is based at our headquarters in Helsinki. We offer extensive employee benefits unique to the K group. These include, among others: Culture & sport benefit (ePassi), shopping benefits that apply in K-Group stores and staff shops, own occupational health care services and leisure time accident insurance. You are also entitled to a car benefit according to our company policy. Several of our partners and customers also offer discounts for their services (e.g. optician, accommodation, sports and wellness). Come join our professional team and start building your own kind of career in K group!

Interested?

The application period ends on 9.10.2026.For more information about the task, please contact your future supervisor Terhi Haajanen, VP, Business services & Controlling. The best way to reach her is by phone on October 6 and October 8 between 14:00 and 15:00 (+358 10 532 2582). Please submit your application via the apply -link. We'd love to hear your salary expectations as well.

The selected candidate will be subject to a credit check and drug testing in accordance with Kesko's recruitment and employment practices.

We at K Group value diversity and believe that different backgrounds and perspectives are key to success. We strive to create a work environment where everyone has the opportunity to grow. Equality, non-discrimination, and fairness are our core principles in recruitment, compensation, and career development.

jobs.title: Pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent søges til Naturly – 37 timer
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for unge – også når dagen ikke går helt efter planen?

Naturly søger en pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent til en fast stilling på 37 timer ugentligt på vores børne- og ungehjem.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan skabe ro, struktur, relation og udvikling omkring unge, som har brug for voksne, der både kan stå fast og være nysgerrige på det, der ligger bag en adfærd.

Hvem er vi?

Naturly er et mindre, privat børne- og ungehjem med 5 pladser efter Barnets Lov § 43 samt 1 fleksibel plads efter Servicelovens § 107.

Vores målgruppe er unge i alderen 12–22 år, som blandt andet kan have ADHD/opmærksomhedsforstyrrelser, angst, stressbelastning, tilknytningsvanskeligheder og erfaringer med omsorgssvigt.

Vi arbejder med KRAP som pædagogisk metode samt en mentaliserende og strukturpædagogisk tilgang.

Hos os skal faglighed ikke kun stå i en metodebeskrivelse. Den skal kunne ses i hverdagen, i relationen til den unge, i vores refleksioner og i vores dokumentation.

Vi søger dig, der

er uddannet pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent, og som har lyst til at arbejde tæt sammen med unge, kolleger og ledelse.

Du må gerne have erfaring fra døgnområdet eller med vores målgruppe, men det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, stabil, ansvarlig og fagligt reflekterende.

Du skal kunne bevare roen, når en ung har svært ved det, være nysgerrig på det, der ligger bag adfærden, og samtidig være tydelig omkring de rammer, der skaber tryghed og forudsigelighed.

Vi prioriterer din faglige udvikling

På Naturly skal man ikke stå alene med de faglige udfordringer. Vi prioriterer tid til refleksion, sparring og udvikling af vores fælles praksis.

Hos os får du blandt andet:

• Løbende supervision
• Faglig sparring med kolleger og ledelse
• Faste faglige drøftelser
• Mulighed for relevante kurser og kompetenceudvikling
• En arbejdsplads med korte beslutningsveje og tæt kontakt til ledelsen
• Mulighed for at være med til at præge og udvikle vores faglige praksis
• Et tværfagligt kollegialt fællesskab med fokus på en fælles faglig retning

Arbejdet foregår i døgnregi, og vagterne vil derfor også omfatte aften, weekend og døgnvagter.

Det vigtigste for os er ikke, om der står pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent på dit eksamensbevis. Det vigtigste er, hvad du bringer med dig ind ad døren – fagligt og menneskeligt.

Stillingen: Fastansættelse, 37 timer ugentligt.
Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt eller efter aftale.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen eller Naturly, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Naturly – et lille sted med plads til udvikling.

jobs.title: Technicien / Technicienne de maintenance sécurité alarme incendie (H/F)
jobs.description:
Chez IPSI, c'est C.A.A.R.Ré

CONFIANCE / AUTHENTICITE / AVENTURE HUMAINE / RECONNAISSANCE / REUSSITE

Nos valeurs guident notre quotidien et nous vous invitons à embarquer dans cette aventure palpitante avec nous !

Depuis plusieurs années, notre FIRST Académie a ouvert ses portes à divers talents avec pour objectifs de les former et de les intégrer dans nos équipes !  
De 2018 à aujourd'hui, pour 125 apprenants intégrés, c'est 86% de taux de satisfaction, 86% de réussite au TP et 92% de taux d'insertion dans l'emploi.

Les objectifs de la formation :

Nos apprenants passeront une formation de 3 mois au sein de nos locaux à Ivry sur seine pour apprendre à :

- Réaliser la maintenance préventive et corrective des systèmes de sécurité incendie
- Assurer la traçabilité des opérations effectuées et le conseil du client à l'issue d'une intervention

La formation allie cours théoriques et stage pratique sur site. Lors de son cursus, l'apprenant est accompagné d'un tuteur.

A l'issue de la formation, nous vous embaucherons en tant que technicien de maintenance SSI en CDI avec une période d'essai de 3 mois. Durant cette période, vous continuerez à être accompagné(e) afin de faciliter votre montée en compétences et votre intégration.


Les profils que nous recherchons pour intégrer la formation :

Disposer de connaissances et savoirs faire en électricité / électrotechnique, à minima un Bac pro MELEC ou acquis par l'expérience
Une bonne aisance avec les outils informatiques
Une bonne communication orale et écrite
Une bonne aisance relationnelle et le sens des responsabilités
Etre inscrit.e à France Travail

Notre process de recrutement pour vous intégrer dans cette formation :

Un échange téléphonique avec notre Chargé.e de recrutement
Des tests de prérequis (électricité et logique) et un entretien de motivation en face à face
La validation de votre candidature

Compter environ deux mois de délai entre votre entretien et votre intégration dans la formation.


La formation est entièrement gratuite. Pendant les 3 premiers mois, vous serez rémunéré(e) par France Travail via une indemnité de formation.

La formation se déroulera en Île-de-France. Pour les candidats résidant hors de la région, un hébergement sera mis à disposition durant toute la durée de la formation au sein du centre de formation. Deux allers-retours seront également pris en charge afin de vous permettre de rentrer chez vous le temps d'un week-end.

Si vous vous sentez prêt.e à endosser ce rôle , n'hésitez pas à postuler !

Ensemble, remplissons notre devoir avec détermination et passion !

Ipsi encourage les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap. Des accommodations seront fournies sur demande pour faciliter le processus de candidature.

Ipsi est résolument engagée dans une politique RSE, intégrant des pratiques durables pour un impact positif sur la société et l'environnement.

jobs.title: Directeur / Directrice de structure d'hébergement touristique (H/F)
jobs.description:
Véritable chef d'orchestre de l'expérience client, le Director of Rooms dirige, inspire et coordonne l'ensemble des activités Rooms depuis la préparation du séjour jusqu'au départ du client. Il garantit une expérience fluide, personnalisée et cinq étoiles, conforme au positionnement de La Citadelle et aux standards de marque Emblems Collection.
Il pilote un périmètre large associant hébergement, accueil, expérience client et activités visiteurs, dans un environnement insulaire fortement saisonnier. Il construit une organisation capable d'adapter les ressources permanentes et saisonnières aux niveaux d'activité tout en garantissant la qualité de service et la maîtrise des coûts.
2. PERIMETRE
-Executive Housekeeper / Gouvernant Général
-Réception / Front Office
-Réservations
-Master of the House
-Conciergerie
-Chasseurs / Valets / Bagagistes
-Night Team
-Musée : exploitation opérationnelle, accueil, billetterie et expérience visiteurs
-Kids Club
-Parcours arrivée / séjour / départ et coordination des transferts clients

A. Pré-ouverture & organisation opérationnelle
-Définir l'organisation opérationnelle du département Rooms et les responsabilités de chaque fonction.

-Coordonner la préparation opérationnelle avec Housekeeping, Finance, IT, Technique, F&B, Spa, Sales et RH.

-Développer une culture de personnalisation, d'anticipation et de reconnaissance du client.
-Piloter les VIP, habitués, familles et situations nécessitant une attention particulière.
-Analyser les commentaires, réclamations et indicateurs de satisfaction et mettre en oeuvre les plans d'action nécessaires.

jobs.title: Materiaalikoordinaattori
jobs.description:
Oletko sinä tiimimme seuraava huippuosaaja?

Haemme nyt sisustusmateriaalien materiaalikoordinaattoria liittymään Architectural Accommodation osastolle, joka toimii osana Hotel Design -yksikköä!

Tule mukaan suunnittelemaan ja toteuttamaan maailman edistyksellisimpiä risteilyaluksia ja jätä kädenjälkesi laivanrakennuksen historiaan! Meyer Turku tarjoaa sinulle kannustavan työpaikan, jossa voit kehittyä ja tavoitella omannakoistasi tyouraa.

Hotel Design yksikkömme vastaa laivan kaikkien yleisten tilojen ulkoasusta ja suunnittelusta. Tähän kuuluvat hytit, hyttialueet, julkiset tilat (kuten teatterit, ravintolat ja miehistön julkiset tilat), hotellin palvelutekniset tilat ja arkkitehtoniset ulkoalueet. Yksikön vastuulla on toteuttaa asiakkaamme toimittaman arkkitehtimateriaalin design, sääntöjen, määräysten ja sovitun tason sallimissa puitteissa. Vastaamme myös eri järjestelmien reitityksen, sijainnin ja sijoittelun suunnittelusta sekä rungon suunnitteluun tarvittavien aukkojen koordinoinnista.

Architectural Accommodation osasto vastaa arkkitehtonisista systeemeistä ja sisustusalueiden perussuunnittelun koordinoimisesta. Lisäksi ryhmällä on ADA-, luovutusdokumentaatio-, IHM-, 3D- ja Sustainability spesialistit.

Osana Architectural Accommodation osastoa Material Coordination tiimimme vastaa matkustajille ja miehistölle näkyvien tilojen perussuunnittelusta ja tiettyjen materiaalien hankinnasta – sinun roolisi osana tiimiäsi on varmistaa, että tehtävään liittyvät hankintakokonaisuudet pysyvät hallinnassa moniprojektiympäristössä. Tiloja ovat esimerkiksi mm. hyttialueitten käytävät, sairaala ja ohjaamo.

Tehtävänkuvaus:

Tehtävääsi kuuluu materiaalikoordinaattorille nimetyn kokonaisuuden hallinta. Toimimme moniprojektiympäristössä eli osallistut tehtäväkokonaisuuden vastuullisena samanaikaisesti usean eri laivaprojektin vaiheisiin alusta loppuun. Toteutamme arkkitehtoniset ratkaisut laivanrakennuksen sääntöjen ja määräysten mukaan.

Tehtäväsi on koordinoida telakan rakentamien alueiden sisustusmateriaalien ja kalusteiden hankintoja osana tiimiä. Hankittavia materiaaleja ovat esimerkiksi katto- ja seinämateriaalit, kaiteet, verhot, WC-materiaalit. Valmistelet tekniset määritelmät ja rajaukset hankintoja varten, laadit kyselyaineiston liitteineen ja vastaat tarve- ja toimitusaikatauluista. Hankinnat tapahtuvat yhteistyössä ostajan kanssa.

Tehtävässä olet vastuussa budjetoinnista ja hankintakokonaisuuksiin liittyvien kulujen seurannasta ja hallinnasta. Ennakointi sekä kehitys- ja säästötoimenpiteet kuuluvat vastuullesi.

Tehtävään kuuluu vahva kommunikaatio eri toimijoiden kanssa. Osallistut neuvotteluihin kokonaisuuksien asiantuntijana. Materiaalin ekologisuuden ja soveltuvuuden selvittäminen käyttötarkoitukseen on vastuullasi ja hyväksytät ratkaisut ja toteutuksen tarvittaessa asiakkaallamme sekä tuotannossa.

Materiaaliosaamisen lisäksi tehtävä vaatii ymmärrystä teknisistä vaatimuksista ja ratkaisuista.

Työtehtäväsi ryhmässä muokkautuu ja kehittyy kokemuksesi mukaisesti. Nyt haemme henkilöä kasvamaan vastuulliseen tehtävään.

Mitä odotamme sinulta:

Haemme tiimiimme aktiivista henkilöä, joka kykenee toimimaan tehokkaana ja positiivisena linkkinä niin oman ryhmän, kuin muiden osastojen, asiakkaan, arkkitehtien ja aluerakentajan välillä. Hallitset hyvin aikataulutuksen ja pystyt toimimaan samanaikaisesti usean eri tahon kanssa itsenäisesti.

Sinulla on kyky toimia hektisessä moniprojektiympäristössä, joka taas edellyttää kykyä suunnitella oma ajankäyttö projektien tarpeiden mukaan.

Taitoa ja näkemystä toimia asiakasrajapinnassa, joka on neuvotteluja ja päivittäistä kanssakäymistä telakan projektiosaston, perussuunnittelu- ja sisustusvarustelun osastojen kanssa. Työ sisältää myös materiaalitoimittajien kanssa neuvotteluja ja tiedonvaihtoa läpi projektien. Telakan organisaatiossa edustetaan systeemin parasta osaamista.

Eduksi katsotaan laivateollisuudessa yleisesti käytettyjen sisustusmateriaalien ja toimittajien tuntemus, kustannustieto sekä laivapuolen sääntöjen ja vaatimusten tuntemus.

Seuraavien ohjelmistojen hallintaa: Excel ja muut Office ohjelmat, SAP, Kronodoc /Wave, AutoCad / jonkin 3D ohjelma

Olet oma-aloitteinen, tartut reippaasti toimeen ja haluat olla mukana luomassa positiivista ja kannustavaa ilmapiiriä. Eduksi on, että sinulla on kokemusta projektikoordinoinnista ja tehtävään sopiva koulutus. Lisäksi tarvitset hyvää suullista ja kirjallista englannin kielen taitoa.

Kokemus laivanrakennuksesta katsotaan eduksi, mutta meillä kasvat laivanrakentajaksi kokeneiden osaajien opastuksessa.

Huomioithan, että edellytämme valitulta henkilöltä hyväksyttyä huumausainetestiä sekä terveystarkastuksessa todettua sopivuutta työsuhteen tehtäviin.

Miksi tulla meille töihin?

Pääset työskentelemään laivanrakennuksen huipulla. Maailman edistyksellisimmät risteilyalukset suunnitellaan ja rakennetaan Meyer Turun telakalla. Meidät tunnetaan huipputeknologisesta osaamisestamme, monialaisesta tuotannostamme sekä innovatiivisista ratkaisuistamme, jotka vievät koko laivanrakennusalaa eteenpäin. Tilauskantamme ulottuu pitkälle tulevaisuuteen. Vuonna 2024 liikevaihtomme oli 1,82 miljardia euroa ja työntekijöitä oli noin 2 200.

Olet osa huipputekijöiden porukkaa. Meillä on osaamista, jota ei löydy mistään muualta. Telakallamme on yli 450 ammattia, ja olemme kaikki laivanrakentajia – jokaisen työpanosta tarvitaan yhteisen päämäärän saavuttamiseen.

Saat myötätuulta urallesi. Kannustamme työntekijöitämme kehittymään, oppimaan uutta ja tarttumaan tilaisuuksiin. Mahdollistamme pitkät työurat: uusia, mielenkiintoisia työtehtäviä löytyy usein oman organisaatiomme sisältä.

Työsuhde-edut ovat kohdallaan. Telakan oma työterveysasema tarjoaa monipuolisia palveluja, apua ja tukea koko työurasi ajan. Vapaa-ajalla voit käydä Meyer Turun kuntosalilla, osallistua monipuolisten harrastusryhmiemme toimintaan tai käyttää liikunta- ja kulttuurietuja muihin harrastuksiisi.

Kysyttävää:

Taru Rein, Head of Team, Architectural Accommodation, Hotel Design Department

+358408261866

Soittoajat klo 8-16 välillä.

taru.rein@meyerturku.fi

jobs.title: AI Lead, Marine
jobs.description:
We are looking for an AI Lead for the Marine Business Unit to take ownership of Marine-specific AI development and turn business and engineering needs into practical solutions.

As part of the Marine Business Unit strategy, we are increasing our focus on artificial intelligence to improve competitiveness, efficiency, engineering processes, and ways of working. The role bridges technology, engineering and business, turning Marine challenges into AI-driven solutions and leading initiatives from idea to implementation.

Your role and the team

As our Marine AI Lead, you will drive the adoption and development of AI solutions across our Marine Business Unit. You will identify and prioritize high-value AI opportunities, translate business needs into practical development initiatives, and lead projects from concept to implementation. You will also own and develop the Marine AI roadmap and initiative pipeline, ensuring that the most valuable opportunities are identified, prioritized, and translated into practical solutions.

In this role, you will act as the bridge between business and technology, working closely with marine engineering experts, the Group AI team, and external partners. You will evaluate emerging AI technologies, guide technology choices, and ensure that AI solutions deliver tangible value to ship design, engineering, and business processes.

Initially, the role is highly hands-on, combining strategic ownership with practical experimentation, prototyping, and solution development. As our AI capabilities grow, the role may evolve into leading a broader Marine AI development function.

Success in this role means:

- Turning business and engineering challenges into practical AI solutions
- Driving and prioritizing a strong pipeline of AI initiatives
- Making informed technology and development decisions

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

  • Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million
  • Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics
  • Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases
  • Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements
  • Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level
  • Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments
  • Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance
  • Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

  • Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option
  • Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate
  • The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently
  • The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers
  • The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages
  • The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications
  • A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

  • A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development
  • A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group
  • Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation
  • Good opportunities for both professional and personal development
  • Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance
  • A good canteen scheme and active staff association
  • An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

If you have any questions about the position or the BIRN Group, please feel free to contact Group CSO Peter Frost Jepsen on tel. +45 3016 0160 or Group HR Manager Morten Madsen on tel. +45 3016 0115.

Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis and will close the position once we have found the right candidate. As mentioned above, the start date can be adjusted to suit the right candidate. Please submit your application via our recruitment system, which you will find at [insert link]. Candidates who proceed to a second interview can expect to complete a personality profile as part of the process.

We would encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity or age, to apply for the position.

jobs.title: Tiler
jobs.description:
The duties of a waterproofer and tiler include a wide range of wet-room and tiling work in both new-build and renovation projects. Work areas include bathrooms, toilets, saunas, utility rooms, kitchens, and other interior and exterior spaces requiring tiling.

The duties include:

- Reviewing construction drawings and work instructions

- Protecting the work area and inspecting the condition of the substrate

- Removing old tiles, waterproofing membranes, and other surface materials when necessary

- Cleaning, sanding, levelling, and straightening wall and floor surfaces

- Checking floor slopes and correcting them when necessary

- Applying primers and preparing surfaces

- Waterproofing wet rooms in accordance with the system manufacturers instructions

- Carefully sealing corners, penetrations, joints, and floor drains

- Measuring, planning, setting out, and installing wall and floor tiles

- Cutting, drilling, and fitting tiles

- Preparing and applying tile adhesive

- Grouting tiled surfaces and applying silicone sealant

- Epoxy grouting and other specialist grouting when required

- Cleaning, finishing, and protecting completed surfaces


The work involves handling various types of tiles, including ceramic tiles, clinker tiles, mosaics, and natural-stone tiles. The employee must be able to use the materials, machinery, tools, and equipment required for waterproofing and tiling work.

The position requires care, precision, high-quality workmanship, and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team. The employee must be able to read construction drawings, take the necessary measurements, follow site schedules, and comply with material manufacturers installation instructions.

Aaltovoima Lapland Chef Academy

17–18 October 2026 | Helsinki | 10:00–17:00

Aaltovoima Pohjoinen is organising the Aaltovoima Lapland Chef Academy – a free, two-day intensive training programme where you can develop your professional skills under the guidance of top-level professionals and build a concrete pathway towards seasonal work in Lapland.

Two intensive days

Certificate of completion

A pathway to employment
Aaltovoima will connect participating chefs with suitable job opportunities in hotels and restaurants across Lapland during the upcoming winter season.

act digital est un groupe international de conseil et d'ingénierie qui accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets de transformation numérique.

Le poste :

Vous intégrerez, au sein de notre Pôle Cybersécurité, une équipe dédiée à l'accompagnement de nos clients sur des missions de gouvernance, de gestion des risques et de définition de cadres de référence SSI. Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un profil expérimenté en gouvernance cybersécurité, disposant de solides connaissances sur les sujets IT Continuity, IT Resilience, Backup & Restore et Cloud Security, capable de contribuer à la formalisation et à l'évolution des exigences et procédures Groupe.

Vos missions seront les suivantes :
- Contribuer à la rédaction, à la révision et à la structuration des exigences cybersécurité et procédures Groupe sur les sujets IT Continuity, IT Resilience, Backup & Restore et Cloud Security
- Accompagner les travaux de Cloud Security et contribuer à l'interprétation ainsi qu'à l'application des exigences de sécurité et de continuité dans les environnements Cloud
- Prendre en compte les différents modèles de services Cloud (IaaS, PaaS, CaaS et SaaS) ainsi que les modèles de responsabilités partagées entre le Groupe et les Cloud Service Providers
- Contribuer à la définition des exigences relatives aux enjeux de continuité, de résilience, de sauvegarde, de restauration, de due diligence et de réversibilité dans les environnements Cloud
- Participer aux travaux de gouvernance cybersécurité : analyse des besoins, formalisation des livrables, préparation des supports de décision et suivi des actions
- Animer et faciliter des workshops en anglais avec les différentes entités et fonctions du Groupe afin de cadrer les attendus, partager les livrables et recueillir les retours opérationnels
- Contribuer à l'alignement des exigences avec les cadres de référence cybersécurité, les bonnes pratiques de continuité et de résilience IT ainsi que les exigences réglementaires applicables

Profil recherché :

Quel profil pour ce poste :
- Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation Bac+5 (École d'ingénieur, Université ou équivalent) en informatique, cybersécurité ou gestion des risques
- Vous justifiez d'une expérience confirmée dans des fonctions de gouvernance cybersécurité, de définition d'exigences, de standards ou de procédures SSI
- Vous disposez d'une expérience significative sur les problématiques de continuité et de résilience des systèmes d'information, idéalement complétée par une connaissance des environnements Cloud
- Vous avez déjà évolué dans un environnement complexe et transverse, impliquant de nombreux interlocuteurs techniques, cybersécurité, risques et métiers
- Vous accordez de l'importance à la rigueur, à la qualité rédactionnelle et à la structuration des livrables
- Vous disposez d'une bonne capacité de synthèse, d'autonomie et êtes à l'aise dans l'animation de workshops avec des interlocuteurs internationaux

Quelles compétences/connaissances pour ce poste :
- Solides connaissances des problématiques IT Continuity, IT Resilience, PRA/PCA et des principes de continuité des systèmes d'information
- Bonne compréhension des stratégies de Backup & Restore, incluant les principes de sauvegarde, restauration, tests et exigences associées
- Connaissance des environnements Cloud et des modèles de services IaaS, PaaS, CaaS et SaaS
- Compréhension des modèles de responsabilités partagées entre les organisations et les Cloud Service Providers
- Expérience dans la rédaction d'exigences cybersécurité, standards, politiques et procédures SSI
- Connaissance des problématiques de sécurité, de continuité, de réversibilité et de gestion des risques dans les environnements Cloud
- Bonne compréhension des cadres de référence et bonnes pratiques cybersécurité
- Anglais courant impératif

jobs.title: Bid Manager
jobs.description:
At VARD, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for the global maritime industry. Combining engineering excellence, cutting-edge technology, and strong teamwork, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced vessels.

At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We foster an inclusive and supportive environment where talents can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make an impact.

Vard Interiors is a leading supplier of turnkey interior, insulation, piping, and HVAC-R solutions for the maritime industry. As part of the VARD value chain, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to create functional, sustainable, and high-quality onboard environments. With a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and customer value, we help bring some of the industry’s most advanced vessels to life.

We are currently looking for a Bid Manager to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities
  • Lead and coordinate the bid process for assigned sales projects.
  • Prepare and review cost calculations and commercial proposals.
  • Develop and review technical proposals for customers.
  • Maintain and improve cost estimation tools, routines and databases.
  • Conduct cost analyses and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
  • Perform risk assessments and maintain risk registers throughout the sales process.
  • Collaborate with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders to clarify project scope and requirements.
  • Facilitate project handover from Sales to Project Execution.
  • Support the continuous development of estimating methodologies and best practices
Qualifications
  • Relevant higher education, or equivalent experience.
  • Good written and spoken English and Norwegian skills.
  • Knowledge of vessel interiors, HVAC and piping systems.
  • Understanding of shipbuilding processes and the maritime industry.
  • Experience with cost estimation, commercial analysis or bid management is an advantage.
  • Proven experience in securing contracts and delivering successful bids is considered a plus.

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
  • Commercially minded with a strong business understanding.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented, with excellent problem-solving abilities.
  • Proactive and solution-oriented in your approach to work.
  • Able to manage multiple priorities and deliver under tight deadlines.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
  • Resilient, focused and able to perform effectively under pressure
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you

  • Subsidized membership at the gym

VARD recognizes the importance of having fun at work, this is why with Social by VARD you will have the chance to bond with colleagues through new experiences and shared interests. We are looking for DESTINATION GUIDE for our client, Lapland Hotels SnowVillage, for the winter season 2026-2027.

The role of a Destination Guide is international and diverse. The work includes, among other duties, leading guided tours for groups in the snow and ice world. Employment begins on November 23, 2026, and is expected to continue until April 4, 2027. Full-time work is available at 112.5 hours per three-week period. The employment contract will be concluded between the employee and Staffpoint.

We hope you have

- Previous experience in customer service and strong group management skills

- A positive attitude reflected in the way you work

- Readiness to work in a busy and international environment

- Motivation to work in a dynamic and versatile role

- In addition to English, proficiency in German, French, or Spanish is considered an advantage

We offer you

- Interesting and varied work in a pleasant, active, and enjoyable work environment

- A fantastic and close-knit team that many employees return to season after season

- Comprehensive employee benefits across three business areas (Lapland Hotels, Lapland Safaris, and Lapland Ski Resorts)

- Accommodation arranged by the client

- Salary negotiable based on experience, but at minimum according to the collective agreement for the hospitality industry (Marava TES) plus applicable supplements


Lapland Hotels SnowVillage uniquely combines the magical worlds of snow and ice. Every year in November, a one-of-a-kind icy attraction covering approximately two hectares is built in Lainio, featuring ice sculptures, an ice restaurant, and an ice bar. Reception and restaurant facilities, however, are comfortably located within warm log-built surroundings.

Smiling customer service and creating memorable experiences are the core values of SnowVillage. Lapland Hotels SnowVillage welcomes approximately 80,000 visitors annually, and the theme changes every year. Its location near the Levi and Ylläs ski resorts ensures a busy winter season. SnowVillage is approximately 45 km from Levi, 30 km from Äkäslompolo, and 15 km from Ylläsjärvi.

The accommodation is located approximately 15 km from the workplace, so a car or a driving licence is essential.

Please note that we process applications throughout the application period. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found. Submit your job application and we'll see you in magical Lapland! Please note that we do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. All applications should be submitted through our website.


Lapland Hotels

Lapland Hotels & Safaris Oy offers northern experiences for all senses. It consists of Finland's largest private hotel chain Lapland Hotels, the Nordic region's largest program service company Lapland Safaris, and Lapland Ski Resorts. The entire group employs a total of about 1,950 people.

Lapland Hotels includes 20 hotels, over 2,600 rooms and apartments, and more than 11,000 restaurant seats throughout Finland: in Ylläs, Levi, Saariselkä, Rovaniemi, Olos, Luosto, Kilpisjärvi, Pallas, and Hetta, as well as in Helsinki, Tampere, Oulu, Kuopio, and Kartano & Spa Hotel Haikko in Porvoo.

Lapland Safaris offers unique nature activities in Lapland's five locations: Rovaniemi, Ylläs, Saariselkä, Levi, and Luosto. An essential part of the safari selection is dog sledding experiences, which are provided by Lapland Husky Safaris, a member of the same tourism group. The company is the largest operator in its field in Finland and has four kennels in Rovaniemi, Luosto, Saariselkä, and Muonio. Lapland Ski Resorts consists of five ski resorts located in Ylläs, Luosto, Olos, Pallas, and Rovaniemi

jobs.title: Data Scientist for Department of Biology
jobs.description:
We are Earth scientists who accumulate large data sets on the composition of sedimentary rocks in geologic time on modern sediments from throughout the world. Our ambition is to generate coupled interactive data sets, where data can be easily extracted, and compared with other literature data sets. What we need is a data scientist to help us organize and curate our data, to extract data from the literature and to generate computational platforms for data analysis. A GIS framework will be important for some of the data organization analyses.

Overall, we need someone who is motivated, with good ideas as to how data bases can be organized and manipulated and with skills using GIS. To be considered for this position the applicants should have a PhD degree. 

The data scientist will be part of the Nordcee research group and specifically the Canfield Villum group exploring the relationship between the evolution of the Earth’s
chemical environment and the evolution of life. The position is based at the Department of Biology.

The position will run from February 1 2027 until June 30, 2029.

Salary and employment terms
Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Vil du forme fremtidens grønne og levende arbeidsplasser på Sunnmøre?
jobs.description:
Er du en relasjonsbygger som motiveres av å skape visuelle endringer og bedre trivsel for ansatte?

 

Har du lyst til å selge et produkt alle vil ha, og som beviselig forbedrer arbeidsmiljøet? Safari Planter AS opplever solid vekst, og nå søker vi deg som vil ta eierskap til B2B-markedet vårt i Ålesund og omegn.

 

Hvorfor er dette en unik mulighet?

De fleste selger software, forsikring eller kaffemaskiner. Hos Safari Planter selger du en opplevelse, bedre inneklima og estetiske arbeidsplasser. Grønne vegger, spektakulære atriumløsninger og skreddersydd planteinteriør er i vinden som aldri før. Bedrifter investerer tungt i å få de ansatte tilbake til kontoret – og her sitter du med nøkkelen.

 

Som B2B-selger hos oss får du en sjelden kombinasjon av kreativ rådgivning og rendyrket business-to-business-salg. Du blir vårt ansikt utad mot regionens mest spennende bedrifter, eiendomsutviklere og arkitekter.

 

 

Hva vil hverdagen din bestå i?

Du vil ha stor frihet til å legge opp din egen arbeidsdag, med base fra vårt kontor i Ålesund. Hovedfokus er å fylle egen portefølje og skape grønnere rom for næringsliv og offentlig sektor:

 

  • Oppsøkende salg og relasjonsbygging: Du identifiserer muligheter, booker møter og bygger langsiktige partnerskap med beslutningstakere.
  • Kreativ rådgivning: Du lytter til kundens behov og tegner ut helhetlige løsninger i grensesnittet mellom interiør, arkitektur og biophilia (menneskets behov for natur).
  • Anbud og prosjekter: Du driver prosessene fra første kontakt og tilbudsskriving til forhandlinger og avtaleinngåelse – inkludert offentlige anskaffelser.

  • Nettverksbygging: Du representerer Safari Planter på messer, bransjetreff og i samarbeid med lokale arkitekter og interiørarkitekter.

     

 

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter deg som trigges av å lukke avtaler, men som forstår at et godt salg starter med tillit. Du har gjerne erfaring fra prosjektsalg, kapitalvaresalg eller interiørløsninger mot bedriftsmarkedet

 

  • Du er en jeger med rådgiverhatt: Du trives med oppsøkende aktivitet, men fremstår som en profesjonell og lyttende sparringspartner for kunden.
  • Du har kommersiell teft: Du forstår B2B-markedet, hvordan offentlige innkjøp fungerer, og hvordan du posisjonerer Safari Planter som den foretrukne leverandøren.
  • Du har nettverk på Sunnmøre: Det er en stor fordel om du allerede kjenner det lokale næringslivet i regionen.
  • Språk og logistikk: Du kommuniserer flytende på norsk (skriftlig og muntlig), har gode engelskkunnskaper, og førerkort klasse B er et krav da du vil være mye på farten.

 

 

Hva kan vi tilby deg?
  • En attraktiv lønnsmodell: Konkurransedyktig fastlønn i bunn, kombinert med en provisjonsmodell som belønner gode resultater.
  • Høy påvirkningskraft: Vi er en fremoverlent organisasjon der veien fra idé til beslutning er kort. Du får være med på å forme våre fremtidige konsepter og salgsstrategier.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø: Du blir en del av et uformelt, engasjert og faglig sterkt team som brenner for det de leverer.
  • Et takknemlig produkt: Du selger løsninger som bidrar direkte til økt trivsel, lavere sykefravær og flottere visuelle rammer hos kundene dine.

jobs.title: Pneumatic Conveying System Installation and Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Pneumatic Conveying System Installation and Commissioning Engineer to work for a 1 year project in Kotka starting from 8.10.2026 and ending on 7.10.2027

1.Responsible for providing on-site installation guidance for pneumatic conveying equipment (including rotary feeders, bin pumps, pipelines, valves, etc.) at the project site.

2.Responsible for seal testing of compressed air pipeline systems and conveying pipelines, as well as inspection of bracket installations.

3\. Guide local labor in the assembly and positioning of key components such as wear-resistant elbows and diverter valves.

4.Conduct low-pressure and medium-pressure purging tests for the pneumatic conveying system to ensure pipelines are clean and leak-free.

5.Cooperate with the Commissioning Manager in on-site calibration of conveying wind speed, wind pressure, and feeding volume.

6.Document deviations during the installation process and provide immediate feedback to the technical department for correction

Requirements

1. Familiar with the principles of dense-phase/dilute-phase pneumatic conveying, capable of reading complex P&ID (Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams) and pipeline isometric drawings.

2. Proficient in on-site acceptance standards for pipeline welding, flange connections, and pressure testing.

3. Capable of on-site safety supervision for height work and confined space operations.

4. 1-5 years of work experience

Vous exercerez en tant que pédodontiste exclusif ou en bénéficiant d'une formation approfondie en orthodontie, selon votre projet professionnel. jobs.title: Palvelupäällikkö taloushallinnon tiimiin Ouluun
jobs.description:
Johda tiimiä ja kehitä asiakkuuksia

Haluatko yhdistää tiimin ja asiakkuuksien johtamisen sekä kehittämistyön roolissa, jossa pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan? Meillä pääset vetämään asiantuntevaa tiimiä ja rakentamaan sujuvaa arkea sekä asiakkaille että omalle porukallesi. Haemme taloushallinnon tiimiin palvelupäällikköä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen vahvistamaan ammattilaistemme joukkoa Oulussa ja lähipaikkakunnilla. Työntekopaikkana toimii Oulun seutu ja odotamme työskentelyä pääosin Oulun tai lähikuntien toimistollamme.



Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

- Tiimin toiminnan johtaminen annettujen tavoitteiden mukaisesti

- Töiden organisointi ja resursointi

- Asiakkuuksien johtaminen, kehittäminen ja asiakashuolenpito

- Asiantuntijoiden sparraus ja osaamisen kehittäminen

- Palvelun laadun varmistaminen

- Toimintatapojen ja palveluiden kehittäminen sekä muutosten jalkauttaminen omassa tiimissä



Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- Vastuullisen ja monipuolisen roolin, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan

- Osaavan ja tukevan kollegaverkoston, esihenkilön ja hallinnon palvelutiimit

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää sekä omaa että tiimisi osaamista

- Kilpailukykyiset edut: laajennettu työterveys, suoritukseesi perustuva tulospalkkio sekä joustavat hyvinvointiedut (liikunta, kulttuuri, hyvinvointi, työmatkat...)



Tunnistatko itsesi tästä?

- Sinulla on kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja asiakkuuksien johtamisesta

- Osaat organisoida, priorisoida ja delegoida

- Johdat mielelläsi esimerkillä ja innostat muita onnistumaan

- Viestit selkeästi ja rakennat sujuvaa yhteistyötä

- Haluat kehittää toimintaa ja viedä asioita eteenpäin



Meillä pääset osaksi yhteisöä, jossa

- yhdessä tekeminen näkyy arjessa

- tukea saa aina, ja ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava

- arvostamme kehittämishalua, vastuullisuutta ja aitoa kiinnostusta ihmisten johtamiseen



Toimimme Aallon arvojen mukaisesti: Osaan, Palvelen, Huolehdin, Kehityn. Yhdessä muodostamme tilitoimiston – monimuotoisen työyhteisön, työpaikan ja asiantuntijaorganisaation, jossa jokainen meistä voi työskennellä ylpeyttä, tyytyväisyyttä ja turvallisuutta tuntien. Yhteistyö kanssamme perustuu molemminpuoliseen kunnioitukseen, luottamukseen ja rehellisyyteen. Uskomme menestyksen kumpuavan tyytyväisistä asiantuntijoista, jotka mahdollistavat tyytyväiset asiakkaat. Strategiamme ydinajatus kulminoituu Aallon sloganiin Tilitoimistoni.

jobs.title: Wilderness Guide
jobs.description:
**Are you looking for meaningful work in the magical nature of Lapland? Do you want to provide guests with unforgettable experiences away from commercial mass tourism?**

**Flow Lapland Experiences Oy** is a Rovaniemi-based experience and activity service company offering high-quality, authentic, and personalized small-group tours. In our operations, we focus on high safety standards, genuine interactions, and unique nature experiences. We are now looking for a motivated and customer-oriented **Wilderness & Nature Guide**to join our team and create unforgettable moments for our international guests.

Your Versatile Responsibilities

As a guide, you will be the most important link between the customer and Laplands unique nature. Your workday will mainly consist of the following tasks:

- **Northern Lights Tours (Aurora Hunting):** Guiding groups and taking photography of the Northern Lights during evening and nighttime hours.

- **Winter Activities & Day Trips:** Leading diverse nature excursions, such as trips to the iconic Korouoma ice falls area and wildlife park visits.

- **Customer Service:** A warm, active, and attentive approach when interacting with guests from all over the world.

- **Responsibility & Safety:** Ensuring group safety, overall well-being, and tour schedules in arctic conditions.


What We Expect From You

**Requirements:**

- **Language Skills:** Excellent spoken English.

- **Driver's License:** A valid Category B driver's license and strong confidence driving in challenging arctic winter conditions.

- **Attitude:** A positive customer service mindset, flexibility, and strong teamwork skills.

- **Stress Tolerance:** Ability to act responsibly, calmly, and methodically, even in changing situations.


**Considered an Advantage:**

- Previous experience as a wilderness, nature, or activity guide.

- Valid first aid certification (e.g., EA1 / EA2 / Wilderness First Aid).

- Excellent photography skills (especially knowledge of Northern Lights and night photography).

- Proficiency in languages other than English.


What We Offer You

- **An Inspiring Work Community:** We are a close-knit and supportive team where we invest in everyones well-being through friendly competitions, social evenings, and team recreation days.

- **An Eventful Everyday Life:** A diverse and meaningful role in stunning surroundings—you get to experience Lapland's winter, snow-laden forests, and Northern Lights from the best seat in the house.

- **Training & Career Growth:** As a fresh and growing company, we aim to be an exemplary employer in the tourism industry. We offer comprehensive onboarding and genuine opportunities to develop and advance in your career.

- **Flat Hierarchy & Influence:** Our management is involved in daily operations, offering you the opportunity to significantly influence company development, participate in product development, and take on new responsibilities.

- **Remuneration:** We follow the collective agreement for the ski, tourism, restaurant, and leisure service sector (MaRaVa TES). Salary is determined according to the collective agreement or negotiable based on your experience.

ΒΟΗΘΕΙΑ ΣΤΗΝ ΠΑΡΑΣΚΕΥΗ ΑΠΛΩΝ ΠΙΑΤΩΝ ΣΥΜΦΩΝΑ ΜΕ ΟΔΗΓΙΕΣ ΤΟΥ ΣΕΦ ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΣΕ ΠΑΓΚΟΥΣ, ΣΚΕΥΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΞΟΠΛΙΣΜΟ ΠΛΥΣΙΜΟ ΠΙΑΤΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΣΚΕΥΩΝ ΤΑΚΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΑΠΟΘΗΚΕΥΣΗ ΤΡΟΦΙΜΩΝ ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΝΟΝΩΝ ΥΓΙΕΙΝΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΤΗΣ ΟΜΑΔΑΣ ΚΟΥΖΙΝΑΣ ΣΕ ΚΑΘΗΜΕΡΙΝΕΣ ΑΝΑΓΚΕΣ , ΑΤΟΜΟ ΕΥΧΑΡΙΣΤΟ ΚΑΙ ΠΡΟΘΥΜΟ ΓΙΑ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑ , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , MARIA PITSILLIDOU , mpitsillidou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.description: ΟΡΓΑΝΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΚΑΘΗΜΕΡΙΝΗ ΛΕΙΤΟΥΡΓΙΑ ΤΟΥ ΤΜΗΜΑΤΟΣ ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΕΦΑΡΜΟΓΗ ΔΗΜΙΟΥΡΓΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΚΠΑΙΔΕΥΤΙΚΩΝ ΔΡΑΣΤΗΡΙΟΤΗΤΩΝ ΦΡΟΝΤΙΔΑ, ΕΠΙΒΛΕΨΗ ΚΑΙ ΔΙΑΣΦΑΛΙΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ ΤΩΝ ΠΑΙΔΙΩΝ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΑΣΙΑ ΜΕ ΤΗ ΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ, ΤΟ ΕΚΠΑΙΔΕΥΤΙΚΟ ΠΡΟΣΩΠΙΚΟ ΚΑΙ ΤΟΥΣ ΓΟΝΕΙΣ ΩΡΑΡΙΟ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ 08.15 - 17.15, 3 ΜΕΡΕΣ ΤΗΝ ΕΒΔΟΜΑΔΑ, 07.30 - 15.30, 2 ΜΕΡΕΣ ΤΗΝ ΕΒΔΟΜΑΔΑ.   , ΠΤΥΧΙΟ ΝΗΠΙΑΓΩΓΟΥ, ΔΑΣΚΑΛΑΣ, ΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΚΗΣ ΛΕΙΤΟΥΡΓΟΥ Η ΨΥΧΟΛΟΓΟΥ Η • ΔΙΠΛΩΜΑ ΒΡΕΦΟΝΗΠΙΟΚΟΜΟΥ • ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ, ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΡΓΑΝΩΤΙΚΕΣ ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΕΣ • ΠΟΛΥ ΚΑΛΕΣ ΔΕΞΙΟΤΗΤΕΣ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΗΣ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). jobs.title: ΒΟΗΘΟΣ ΚΑΛΟΥΠΣΗΣ
jobs.description: ΒΟΗΘΕΙΑ ΣΤΗΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΗ, ΣΥΝΑΡΜΟΛΟΓΗΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΤΟΠΟΘΕΤΗΣΗ ΚΑΛΟΥΠΙΩΝ ΓΙΑ ΣΚΥΡΟΔΕΤΗΣΕΙΣ. ΜΕΤΑΦΟΡΑ, ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΚΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΞΟΠΛΙΣΜΟΥ. ΚΟΠΗ ΚΑΙ ΠΡΟΣΑΡΜΟΓΗ ΞΥΛΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΛΩΝ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ ΣΥΜΦΩΝΑ ΜΕ ΤΙΣ ΟΔΗΓΙΕΣ ΤΟΥ ΚΑΛΟΥΨΗ. ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΣΤΗΝ ΑΠΟΞΗΛΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΑΠΟΜΑΚΡΥΝΣΗ ΚΑΛΟΥΠΙΩΝ ΜΕΤΑ ΤΗΝ ΟΛΟΚΛΗΡΩΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΩΝ. ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ, ΕΚΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ. ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΞΗΣ ΣΤΟΝ ΧΩΡΟ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΚΑΝΟΝΩΝ ΥΓΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ ΣΤΟ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟ. ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗ ΑΛΛΩΝ ΣΥΝΑΦΩΝ ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΩΝ ΠΟΥ ΑΝΑΤΙΘΕΝΤΑΙ ΑΠΟ ΤΟΝ ΠΡΟΙΣΤΑΜΕΝΟ. , ΚΑΛΗ ΦΥΣΙΚΗ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗΣ ΧΕΙΡΩΝΑΚΤΙΚΗΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ, ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΝΕΥΜΑ. ΔΙΑΘΕΣΗ ΓΙΑ ΜΑΘΗΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΚΠΑΙΔΕΥΣΗ ΣΤΙΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΚΑΛΟΥΠΙΩΝ. ΠΡΟΗΓΟΥΜΕΝΗ ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΕ ΟΙΚΟΔΟΜΙΚΕΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ. , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.title: ΒΟΗΘΟΣ ΣΙΔΕΡΑΣ
jobs.description: ΥΠΟΒΟΗΘΗΣΗ ΣΤΗΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΗ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΑΡΜΟΛΟΓΗΣΗ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΩΝ. ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ, ΚΟΠΗ, ΛΕΙΑΝΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΜΕΤΑΦΟΡΑ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΩΝ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ. ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΣΤΙΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΣΥΓΚΟΛΛΗΣΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΤΟΠΟΘΕΤΗΣΗΣ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΩΝ ΣΤΟΙΧΕΙΩΝ. ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ, ΕΚΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΚΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΩΝ. ΧΡΗΣΗ ΧΕΙΡΟΚΙΝΗΤΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΙΚΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΩΝ ΣΥΜΦΩΝΑ ΜΕ ΤΙΣ ΟΔΗΓΙΕΣ ΤΟΥ ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΥ ΤΕΧΝΙΤΗ. ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΚΑΝΟΝΩΝ ΥΓΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ ΣΤΟΝ ΧΩΡΟ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΟΡΓΑΝΩΣΗΣ ΤΟΥ ΕΡΓΑΣΤΗΡΙΟΥ Η ΤΟΥ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟΥ. , ΚΑΛΗ ΦΥΣΙΚΗ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΔΥΝΑΤΟΤΗΤΑ ΧΕΙΡΩΝΑΚΤΙΚΗΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ, ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΔΙΑΘΕΣΗ ΓΙΑ ΜΑΘΗΣΗ. ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ ΣΕ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΕΡΙΒΑΛΛΟΝ. ΠΡΟΗΓΟΥΜΕΝΗ ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΕ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΕΣ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΕΣ Η ΣΥΝΑΦΕΙΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ. , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.description: ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟΣ ΑΥΤΟΚΙΝΗΤΩΝ ΒΑΡΕΩΝ ΤΥΠΩΝ ΑΣΧΟΛΕΙΤΑΙ ΜΕ ΤΗ ΣΥΝΤΗΡΗΣΗ, ΔΙΑΓΝΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΙΣΚΕΥΗ ΜΕΓΑΛΩΝ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΩΝ ΟΠΩΣ ΦΟΡΤΗΓΑ, ΛΕΩΦΟΡΕΙΑ, ΕΚΣΚΑΦΕΙΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΛΑ ΒΑΡΕΑ ΜΗΧΑΝΗΜΑΤΑ.   , ΓΝΩΣΗ ΧΡΗΣΗΣ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΩΝ ΟΠΩΣ ΧΕΙΡΟΚΙΝΗΤΑ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΑ, ΑΝΥΨΩΤΙΚΑ ΜΗΧΑΝΗΜΑΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΝΙΚΟ ΔΙΑΓΝΩΣΤΙΚΟ ΕΞΟΠΛΙΣΜΟ ΕΛΕΓΧΟΣ ΟΤΙ ΟΙ ΕΠΙΣΚΕΥΕΣ ΕΧΟΥΝ ΟΛΟΚΛΗΡΩΘΕΙ ΣΩΣΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΤΙ ΤΑ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΑ ΕΙΝΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΗ ΓΙΑ ΧΡΗΣΗ ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΑΚΡΙΒΩΝ ΑΝΑΦΟΡΩΝ ΕΠΙΣΚΕΥΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΔΕΛΤΙΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑ , EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy

jobs.title: ΙΣΙΩΤΗΣ ΑΥΤΟΚΙΝΗΤΩΝ ΒΑΡΕΩΣ ΤΥΠΟΥ
jobs.description: ΕΠΙΔΙΟΡΘΩΝΕΙ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΑΝΑΦΕΡΕΙ ΤΟ ΑΜΑΞΩΜΑ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΩΝ ΠΟΥ ΕΧΟΥΝ ΥΠΟΣΤΕΙ ΠΑΡΑΜΟΡΦΩΣΕΙΣ. ΧΡΗΣΙΜΟΠΟΙΕΙ ΕΙΔΙΚΑ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΜΗΧΑΝΗΜΑΤΑ ΓΙΑ ΝΑ ΙΣΙΩΣΕΙ ΛΑΜΑΡΙΝΕΣ, ΝΑ ΔΙΟΡΘΩΣΕΙ ΤΟ ΠΛΑΙΣΙΟ ΚΑΙ ΝΑ ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΕΙ ΤΗΝ ΕΠΙΦΑΝΕΙΑ ΓΙΑ ΒΑΦΗ, ΔΙΑΣΦΑΛΙΖΟΝΤΑΣ ΤΗΝ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΤΗΝ ΑΙΣΘΗΤΙΚΗ ΤΟΥ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΟΣ. , ΓΝΩΡΙΖΕΙ ΝΑ ΧΡΗΣΙΜΟΠΟΙΕΙ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΑ ΟΠΩΣ ΧΕΙΡΟΚΙΝΗΤΑ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΑ, ΑΝΥΨΩΤΙΚΑ ΜΗΧΑΝΗΜΑΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΝΙΚΟ ΔΙΑΓΝΩΣΤΙΚΟ ΕΞΟΠΛΙΣΜΟ. jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer, remote work
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will lead the modernization of our client's ERP system, transitioning legacy Java/GWT interfaces into modern React applications. Operating in a tight-knit, two-person team, you will leverage advanced agent-driven development tools.

You are offered
the opportunity to work 100% remotely on a long-term, stable project. You will have the creative freedom to pioneer agent-based AI development workflows and play a key role in modernizing a business-critical system.

Work tasks

Modernizing a legacy ERP system by transitioning it to a React and Java-based architecture, utilizing agent-based development methods to implement views, design APIs, and build supporting developer tools.
- Build and modernize ERP views, including search interfaces, editors, and dialogs using React
- Design and implement robust REST APIs to support the new frontend architecture
- Refactor legacy Java/GWT user interfaces into a modern React-based application
- Develop tools and validation checks to keep agent-driven development processes on track

We are looking for

- Advanced knowledge of TypeScript and React
- Practical experience working daily with agentic development methods like Claude Code
- Proven ability to read, refactor, and navigate large legacy codebases
- Strong eye for UI/UX design with the ability to identify and fix visual inconsistencies
- Professional proficiency in English

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of Java and REST APIs
- Experience with Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or spatial data analysis
- Experience with cloud services, specifically AWS
- Professional proficiency in Finnish
- Experience building business-critical ERP systems

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Breakfast Waiter/Waitress for a Hotel in Rovaniemi
jobs.description:
AALTOVOIMA - AALLON VOIMALLA TÖIHIN


Were looking for a friendly and customer-oriented Breakfast Waiter/Waitress to join our hotel team. This is a part-time position with around 60 hours over 3 weeks, making it a great opportunity for someone local looking for extra work.

Shifts are in the mornings, usually starting around 7–8 AM and finishing around 12–1 PM. Your role is to make sure breakfast service runs smoothly, guests feel welcome and everything is ready for a great start to their day.

Were looking for someone who enjoys working with people and doesnt mind early mornings. The hotel is located in the city centre, so the location is easy to reach without a car.

We offer:

* Around 60 hours of work over 3 weeks
* A flexible part-time opportunity, ideal as extra work
* Mainly morning shifts, approximately 7–8 AM to 12–1 PM
* A central city location
* A friendly and people-oriented working environment

We appreciate:

* Previous experience in waiting or restaurant service
* Good English skills – English is essential for the role
* A friendly, positive and customer-focused attitude
* Being comfortable with early mornings and interacting with guests
* A reliable and independent approach to work
* The ability to keep things running smoothly during busy breakfast hours

Join our team and send your application through the link today. We review applications already during the application period and the position will be filled as soon as the right person is found.

For more information about the position, please contact:

Noora Kärkinen

040 668 6518

noora.karkinen@aaltovoima.fi



Aalto Henkilöstöpalvelut on monialainen henkilöstöpalveluyritys Suomesta, joka yhdistää työn ja tekijät. Olemme osa laajempaa Workteam Groupia, joka on henkilöstö- sekä palvelualan konserni.

Perusta toiminnallamme on luotettavuus ja joustavuus. Keskeisimpiä arvojamme ovat yhdessä menestyminen, nopea reagointi ja positiivinen palvelu. Jokainen työntekijä ja asiakas on meille tärkeä.

Henkilöstöllämme on kymmenien vuosien kokemus rakentamisen, logistiikan, teollisuuden ja palvelualojen rekrytoinneista henkilöstöpalvelualalla.
