jobs.title: Full-time Driver Lier
jobs.employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD OSLO DISTRIBUSJON
jobs.description:
We’re looking for Full-Time Drivers to join Oda!

At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective grocery system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.

We are hiring for both morning and evening shifts. Please specify what shift you're applying for in your application.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Report directly to our Driver Operating Managers and Team Leaders at your site as an essential part of our dedicated delivery team.

  • Be a Customer Hero: You’ll be on the road bringing groceries and smiles directly to our customers, ensuring a top-notch "Oda experience" at every doorstep.

  • Keep the wheels turning: You’ll handle loading and unloading with speed and care, ensuring every box arrives in perfect condition.

  • Own your ride: You’ll take pride in your van, keeping it clean, presentable, and ready for the road.

  • Pay it forward: You’ll help onboard and train new colleagues, sharing your best tips and tricks from the road.

  • Make us better: We value your brain as much as your driving! You’ll contribute your ideas to help us improve our routines and ways of working.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • A valid driving license (Class B): You have held your license for at least 2 years from the date of issue and feel confident and safe behind the wheel.

  • Good communication skills: Comfortable in speaking and writing English. If you also know Norwegian or another Nordic language, that’s a big plus!


What would be nice to have 💡

  • Enjoy being active and thrive in a physically demanding job

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team

  • A strong work ethic and a "can-do" mindset

  • Service-minded and always looking for the best solutions

  • A genuine desire to make our customers happy

  • Responsible and always prioritize safety in traffic


What we offer 🚀

  • A chance to make a real impact as a Full-Time Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love-while shaking up the grocery industry.

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop-less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • A chance to shape the future of grocery shopping while building a company that’s here to stay.


Practical information

  • Application deadline: We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once the right candidates are found. We encourage you to apply as early as possible.

  • Start date: We're looking for our next great team members to join us this November, with planned start dates in weeks 45-47.

  • The position is based on a rotational shift schedule (35,5 h), working one weekend per month.

  • Working Hours:

    • Morning shifts: starts between 04:15 and 06:00

    • Evening shift: starts between 12:45 and 14:30

  • Position: 100% Full-time

  • Location: Drammensveien 189, 3420 Lierskogen


A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.


We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡


To ensure a fair and efficient process for everyone, we use Hubert, our virtual assistant, to help us with the first selection. 🤖 Keep an eye on your inbox – shortly after applying, you’ll receive an email with an invite to a chat-based interview. Just make sure your email address is correct so the invite finds its way to you!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

jobs.title: Purchaser
jobs.description:
**Who you are**

We are looking for a skilled and business-minded purchaser to join our Procurement organization. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to sourcing and supplier management in a dynamic international environment. This role will work with all types of procurement categories and will cover both Finland and Norway. The position will be based in Finland.

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

- Good understanding of the IKEA business model, strategic landscape, and ways of working

- A strong connection to IKEA culture, values, and vision of creating a better everyday life for the many people

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, Finnish and Swedish.

- Indirect procurement experience Experience in supplier management and development

- Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills Solid knowledge of sourcing and procurement practices, processes, and tools

- Experience working with project management methods and processes

- Good legal knowledge related to procurement and contracts

- Strong financial and commercial understanding

- Knowledge of cost drivers and value creation opportunities

- Experience with SAP Ariba Source-to-Pay processes is considered an advantage


As a person, you are confident navigating change and ambiguity in a fast-paced international environment. You communicate clearly, build trust easily, and can influence stakeholders to drive business results. You enjoy working both independently and collaboratively across functions.

**What you'll be doing day to day**

In this role, you will:

- Build and maintain trusted relationships with business owners to align sourcing plans, drive performance, and deliver results

- Execute sourcing projects throughout the Source-to-Pay process using SAP Ariba, ensuring a strategic and professional procurement approach

- Lead negotiations to optimize costs, improve supplier performance, and create efficient solutions for end users and invoicing flows

- Drive supplier management and performance while ensuring compliance with IWAY and the IKEA Code of Conduct

- Continuously monitor local supplier markets and provide insights on sourcing opportunities, market developments, and trends

- Collaborate closely with colleagues across functions and markets as one integrated team

- Implement and communicate global procurement strategies, category plans, and strategic priorities within assigned markets and categories

- Deliver value-adding and sustainable procurement solutions that meet business and customer needs


**Together as a team**

Ingka Procurement is part of Ingka Group. Together, we bring IKEA to millions of customers in more than 30 countries around the world.

As IKEA continues to grow, developing a sourcing and supply setup that can grow with us becomes increasingly important. Together with colleagues and suppliers worldwide, we identify and meet business needs in innovative, cost-effective, and sustainable ways.

Our mission is to secure a high-performing supplier base that supports long-term business goals and contributes to a stronger, more efficient value chain. By combining commercial focus with sustainability and collaboration, we aim to create meaningful and better procurement for the many people.

**Apply now!**

This position is full time 37,5 h/week and permanent. We hope you can start in the position on 2.11.2026 or later, by agreement.

Main working place is located in the IKEA Espoo service office. We will review applications continuously and look forward to receiving your application in English, including your CV and motivational letter with salary request, no later than 4.10.2026. Apply for the position via the IKEA careers site, we do not accept applications by email.

The salary for the position starts at €3940 per month and will be specified based on the experience, skills and final content of the position during the recruitment process.

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Recruiter Anna-Maija Korko at anna-maija.korko@ingka.ikea.com.

For role-specific questions, please contact Hiring Manager Ulrika White in english at ulrika.white@ingka.ikea.com

We look forward to receiving your application!

Need adjustments? If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at recruitment.ikea.fi@ikea.com. Were happy to help.

**IKEA, more than a job**

World needs more people like you. So do we. Come to work with us just as you are.

Working at IKEA is more than just a job – with us you are part of an equal and diverse working community. A sense of belonging is important to our employees, and team spirit is at the heart of what we do. IKEA offers a variety of career paths and opportunities to develop yourself in roles that are right for you. We give you the opportunity to bring your ideas to the table to help us develop our work, and to create new IKEA success!

In addition to your salary, you will also enjoy a wide range of comprehensive staff benefits, including flexible Epassi saldo, staff discounts on our products, healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch menus at very low prices in our staff restaurants, One IKEA Bonus, gifts on special days and at Christmas, and much more!

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
Finance Manager (Corporate Finance)
Strategic Finance, Corporate
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a member of the Corporate Finance team, you'll own the consolidated view of Notion's financial performance — the corporate model, the monthly close-to-reporting cycle, and the numbers that reach our executive team, Board of Directors, and investors. You'll immediately take ownership of core corporate FP&A workstreams, which include the consolidated P&L forecast, the monthly budget-vs-actual and reforecast cycles, and the planning systems that produce them.

 

This role is based San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the consolidated corporate model and the monthly reporting cadence — close actuals, budget-vs-actual, and the rolling reforecast — and connect reported performance to the revenue, headcount, and spend drivers behind it

 - Maintain and evolve Notion's planning system, primarily Pigment: maintain the corporate model structure, run the monthly data loads and scenario snapshots, reconcile the P&L, headcount, and departmental views, and build new models and views as the business changes

 - Assist in preparing and delivering presentations that effectively communicate Notion's financial performance and outlook to Notion's executive team, Board of Directors, and investors

 - Raise the quality and scalability of our reporting infrastructure, using AI, automation, and stronger data workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and surface insights faster — challenging existing processes and data inconsistencies that get in the way

 - Work cross-functionally across Accounting, BizTech, People, and our Business Partnership (BP) Finance team to keep source data, mappings, and the chart of accounts aligned as operating complexity grows — tightening the handoffs between close and forecast along the way




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 2-5 years of experience across Investment Banking, Private Equity, Big 4, or corporate FP&A / Strategic Finance at a high-growth SaaS technology company

 - Demonstrated ability to build and own rigorous financial models, ideally a three-statement or consolidated operating model for a recurring-revenue or SaaS business

 - Hands-on experience with an enterprise planning tool (Pigment, Anaplan, Adaptive, Vena) or a clear track record of becoming fluent in new systems quickly

 - Strong analytical judgment and the ability to move from detailed data to a clear point of view on performance, risks, and opportunities

 - Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments and communicate clearly with both financial and non-financial audiences

 - Ability to build finance processes from scratch and improve existing ones with a lens on long-term scalability and sustainability




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $120,000 - $150,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) - Siemens Advanta (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
As an (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) at Siemens Advanta’s Strategy and Innovation Practice, you will serve as a senior leader overseeing pivotal domains: Delivery, Business Development, and People & Capability Building. Leveraging advanced expertise and leadership acumen, you will help define the next era of digitalization by crafting groundbreaking strategies and transformation roadmaps for Siemens and its global customers. The role entails direct responsibility for shaping business success, managing high-value projects, and serving as a trusted advisor for customer executives at C-level.Building on Siemens Advanta’s legacy as a global management consultancy powerhouse, the (Associate) Vice President role combines strategic depth, operational ownership, and cultural leadership—providing exposure to innovation-driven industries such as electrification, automation, and digitalization. **Ready to take your vision to the next level? Be part of a team where strategy meets technology, and innovation drives global impact.**How you will make an impact with us:

- Delivery Excellence:- Act as a trusted advisor to our customers, shaping strategic agendas and transformation roadmaps with your thought leadership.- Take operational and financial responsibility for acquiring and delivering high quality projects.- Oversee multidisciplinary teams in complex consulting engagements and large-scale programs to deliver innovative, tailored digital and organizational solutions for global industrial customers.
- Business Growth:- Shape strategic customer opportunities through thought leadership, innovative methodologies, and differentiated consulting approaches at the intersection of strategy, digitalization, and technology.- Lead the development of compelling value propositions, proposals, and solution concepts for complex transformation initiatives in close collaboration with Customer Partners and senior customer stakeholders.- Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, acting as a strategic advisor and fostering long-term partnerships across complex stakeholder environments.- Leverage Siemens’ unique expertise in industrial technology, automation, digitalization, and AI to create measurable value for customers and strengthen Siemens Advanta’s market positioning and growth.
- People & Capability Building- Develop differentiating methodologies, foster team growth, mentor employees, and build Consulting Excellence within the organization.- Inspire, coach, and grow high-performing, diverse teams ensuring an inclusive, performance-oriented consulting culture.

What you bring:

- Education: - Master’s degree or MBA from a top-tier university is desirable.- Backgrounds in engineering, physics, natural sciences, or strategic management are highly valued.
- Experience & Skills- Extensive consulting experience (8 - 12+ years), with a proven track record as Principal, (Associate) Partner or VP at a top-tier strategy consultancy, or equivalent experience in corporate strategy roles.- Track record in driving significant business growth**,** leading large-scale transformation programs, and building executive-level customer relationships.- Proven track record in leading digital transformation projects for Siemens’ customer base, focusing on industries like automotive and power & utilities.- AI expertise: Strong familiarity with AI-based strategy development and execution, leveraging AI to create impactful industry transformations.- End-to-end experience, ranging from strategy development to hands-on execution for technology-driven and industry-specific transformation projects.- Methodological depth in areas such as Target Operating Model (TOM), cost reduction initiatives, sustainability, and AI transformation.
- Working Style & Personality- Ability to thrive in a matrix organization, fostering strong internal partnerships and cross-functional collaboration.- Extensive experience leading international teams and actively creating an inclusive environment.- A leader who develops people, enjoys leading employees, brings diverse perspectives, thinks creatively, and goes beyond standard consulting approaches.- An entrepreneurial mindset and strong analytical acumen.
- Languages: The position can be filled in either Munich,Germany or Barcelona,Spain.
- Pathway 1: For candidates working in Munich and supporting primarily German-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in English is mandatory, while German is an advantage.- Pathway 2: For candidates working in Barcelona and supporting primarily Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in Spanish is mandatory, with proficiency in Portugese preferred.

What we offer you

- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

Siemens Advanta is a strategic consultant and trusted implementation partner for enterprise-wide digital and sustainable transformations. jobs.title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Platform (Foundations Lead)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Data Foundations team builds and operates the batch and streaming infrastructure behind our product features, analytics, search, and AI experiences. We’re looking for a hands-on technical leader to shape the next generation of this platform as Notion serves larger customers, expands globally, and supports more data-intensive products. You’ll identify the highest-leverage problems, set direction, build and develop a high-performing team, and lead multi-quarter initiatives across our data lake, streaming, distributed-compute, governance, and reliability systems. You’ll stay close to critical technical decisions while creating clear ownership, growing engineers and technical leaders, and helping the team execute as one—partnering closely with Data Engineering, Data Product, Search, AI, Infrastructure, and Security.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Set the direction for Data Foundations. Turn ambiguous company and customer needs into a clear multi-quarter strategy across the data lake, streaming, distributed compute, governance, and platform reliability—and align engineers and partner teams around it.

 - Build and develop a high-performing team. Attract strong engineers, set clear expectations, grow technical leaders, and create an environment of ownership, direct feedback, and accountability.

 - Lead the team’s hardest initiatives from idea to operation. Ensure complex work has strong technical ownership, de-risk architectures through prototypes, break work into shippable milestones, and coordinate execution across engineers and teams.

 - Make Notion’s data platform enterprise-ready. Guide the team toward durable foundations for external key management, data residency, access controls, lifecycle management, and governance without creating separate systems for every requirement.

 - Raise reliability, simplicity, and cost efficiency. Identify systemic risks and architectural gaps, establish clear service ownership, and lead migrations that make Kafka, Debezium, S3/Iceberg, Spark, EMR, Athena, and related systems easier to operate at scale.

 - Multiply the engineering organization. Establish reusable abstractions and paved paths, delegate meaningful ownership, raise the quality of technical decisions, and scale expertise through coaching, documentation, tooling, design reviews, and direct collaboration.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Deep data-platform expertise. You have designed and operated large-scale batch and streaming systems and can reason across storage, compute, ingestion, orchestration, serving, governance, and production operations.

 - Direction-setting leadership. You have led a Data Platform or infrastructure team through multi-quarter work—finding the right problems, defining a strategy, sequencing execution, and driving decisions with long-term consequences.

 - Team-building and talent development. You have attracted strong engineers, grown people across career stages, developed technical leaders, and created clarity when expectations or performance needed to change.

 - Hands-on engineering judgment. You stay close to critical systems and designs and know when to prototype, simplify, buy, build, or migrate. You can go deep while preserving ownership for the engineers leading the work.

 - Platform-product thinking. You understand the needs behind partner requests and turn repeated patterns into safe, ergonomic, self-serve capabilities rather than accumulating bespoke solutions.

 - Organizational influence. You create clarity across team boundaries, surface uncomfortable technical or organizational risks early, and help engineers do their best work through strong context, delegation, feedback, and coaching.

 - You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, move faster, and build more creatively.




THE SYSTEMS AND PROBLEMS YOU MAY LEAD

 - Evolving Notion’s data lake toward an S3 + Iceberg lakehouse with stronger governance, discoverability, schema evolution, and lifecycle controls

 - Scaling Kafka and Debezium-based streaming infrastructure that powers real-time product, analytics, and AI use cases

 - Improving Spark and distributed-compute performance, workload isolation, developer experience, and cost efficiency

 - Designing EKM, data residency, and compliant processing capabilities across Notion’s data estate

 - Creating clear platform interfaces and self-serve primitives for Data Engineering, Search, AI, and product teams




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Notion’s data infrastructure is no longer only an internal analytics layer. It increasingly powers customer-facing features, AI systems, enterprise controls, and high-volume product workflows. The team needs a leader who can see across these systems, build the technical leadership and operating culture required for that responsibility, and find the problems that matter before they become roadmap blockers. Success means Data Foundations has a strong, growing team with clear direction and dependable execution—and teams across Notion can build ambitious data-powered products faster without compromising customer trust.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $281,000 - $334,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Commerce & Payments
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Make Replit the single place where businesses can buy everything they need through their agents. As a Staff Software Engineer on Replit’s Money team, you’ll set technical direction and build the commerce platform that lets users discover, evaluate, purchase, and manage the products and services they need to build and run their businesses—without leaving Replit.

 

Replit already enables businesses to accept payments through integrations such as Stripe. This role builds on that foundation to expand what businesses can buy and accomplish through Replit Agent. You’ll design commerce experiences that combine the simplicity consumers expect with the controls enterprises need, making agent-assisted purchasing useful, trustworthy, and reliable.

 

You’ll own architecture and lead cross-team delivery across merchant and service-provider integrations, agent tools, purchasing workflows, and the lifecycle after a transaction. The challenge goes beyond executing a payment: agents need to understand what a user wants, present clear choices and costs, act within delegated authority, and verify that the purchase delivered the intended outcome. You’ll stay hands-on with design and code while aligning partners, mentoring engineers, and turning an ambitious product vision into incremental customer value.

Set the architecture and technical roadmap for agentic commerce, making Replit a single place to discover, buy, and manage the products and services businesses need.




YOU WILL:

 - Lead end-to-end purchasing experiences through Replit Agent: translate user intent into relevant options, communicate prices and terms, obtain appropriate authorization, execute purchases, and confirm fulfillment or provisioning.

 - Build extensible integrations with merchants, software vendors, and service providers so the platform can expand its commerce offering without rebuilding each workflow from scratch.

 - Build on existing Stripe and payments capabilities, extending payment integrations where needed to support new purchasing experiences rather than treating basic payment acceptance as a greenfield problem.

 - Design agent-facing APIs and tools with clear contracts, secure credentials, scoped permissions, spending limits, and appropriate confirmation for consequential actions.

 - Partner with product and security to support enterprise purchasing requirements such as role-based access, approval workflows, purchasing policies, and auditable transaction histories, while keeping simpler purchases easy.

 - Own the purchase lifecycle beyond checkout: provisioning and access, order and subscription state, receipts, renewals, cancellations, refunds, and reconciliation across providers.

 - Make agent-driven transactions reliable with idempotency, verified events, durable state, safe retries, and recovery from partial failures; evaluate whether workflows complete the authorized task without duplicate purchases or unintended spend.

 - Lead ambiguous initiatives across teams, define incremental milestones, stay hands-on with implementation, and raise the engineering bar through mentoring, design reviews, and production ownership.
   
   


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - A track record of Staff-level technical leadership on complex customer-facing products or platforms, taking ambiguous initiatives from architecture through launch and production operation across multiple teams.

 - Strong hands-on engineering and system design skills, including API design, data modeling, distributed workflows, and thoughtful evolution of existing systems.

 - Experience building extensible third-party integrations and handling asynchronous events, duplicate requests, partial failures, and changing provider capabilities.

 - Strong product judgment: you can turn complex, multi-step workflows into simple user experiences and balance rapid delivery with correctness and long-term flexibility.

 - A security-conscious approach to authentication, authorization, credentials, sensitive data, and actions performed on a user’s or organization’s behalf.

 - Demonstrated ability to align engineering and cross-functional partners on technical direction, document decisions clearly, and drive execution without relying on reporting authority.

 - Experience mentoring engineers and improving the quality of architecture, implementation, and operations beyond your own projects.

 - Comfort using AI-assisted development tools while taking responsibility for the correctness, security, and maintainability of the code you ship.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building commerce platforms, marketplaces, purchasing or procurement systems, or products that connect buyers with multiple vendors.

 - Experience with agent tool calling, multi-step agent workflows, or evaluations for reliable execution of actions against external systems.

 - Familiarity with payment and purchase lifecycles, including authorization, checkout, subscriptions, fulfillment or provisioning, refunds, and reconciliation.

 - Experience building enterprise capabilities such as approval workflows, role-based access, purchasing policies, budget controls, or audit trails.

 - Experience with Stripe or other payment providers, developer platforms, or partner integration ecosystems.

 


BONUS POINTS: 

 - Experience with emerging agentic-commerce protocols, MCP, or delegated authorization for agent-initiated transactions.

 - Experience integrating software and service catalogs, pricing and availability, entitlements, or automated provisioning.

 - Familiarity with recurring and usage-based costs, renewal management, international purchasing, or multi-provider transaction workflows.

 - These are additional strengths, not a checklist; prior experience spanning every commerce domain or payment provider is not expected.



WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Customer outcomes: success means a business can get what it needs through its agent, with clear costs and a verified result—not merely a completed API call.

 - User control and trust: agents act within explicit authority, surface consequential choices, and make purchases and ongoing commitments understandable.

 - Consumer simplicity and enterprise readiness: straightforward experiences should coexist with the controls organizations need.

 - End-to-end ownership: we own the experience from intent through purchase, fulfillment, and ongoing management.

 - Pragmatic technical leadership: we build on what exists, deliver incremental value, and invest in correctness and extensibility where they matter.

 - Clear collaboration: we document decisions, surface risks early, and help other teams and partners succeed.
   



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor and Curator of Mammals
jobs.description:
Tenure Track Assistant Professor / Associate Professor, and Curator of Mammals at Natural History Museum Denmark
The Natural History Museum Denmark wishes to appoint a Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor and Curator of Mammals (mammalia) with a great vision for natural history museums in a changing world. Duties are divided equally between collection-based research and other museum duties including curation of the mammal collections, research-based teaching and supervision of students, public engagement work, and to act as the museum's liaison with relevant Danish natural history communities. The successful applicant will be expected to establish and develop an externally funded collection-based research programme/group and publish in influential journals. We particularly encourage applications from applicants with a collection-based research specialization on mammalogy. The successful applicant will be expected to curate the museum’s historically important mammal collections (56.000 specimens) requiring a thorough understanding and practical knowledge of mammal classification. We value collaboration across disciplines and professions. All applicants are expected to demonstrate interdisciplinary thinking and a commitment to working together to create solutions to global challenges. This also goes for collection work. Curators develop the collections that they are responsible for through research, field work, loan activities, digitization, acting as scientific host for visiting researchers, and increasing accessibility for everyone. This curatorial position in Mammalogy at the Natural History Museum Denmark will be filled at either the Tenure Track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor level. All curators at the Natural History Museum Denmark are expected to take a leading role in society as advocates for science and nature, creating impact at all levels while actively promoting the museum’s Vision and Values (https://snm.dk/en/about-museum). Further details of qualifications required for appointment at the museum are detailed below.

The position is available starting March 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Qualifications
Tenure-track assistant professor
Applicants at the tenure track assistant professor level are expected to have an academic record demonstrating the potential to deliver high profile internationally competitive research in the area of specialization. They should be a scientific specialist in one of the collection areas of the museum and have experience with collection-based research. Previous experience curating natural history collections and university teaching experience would be advantageous but is not a requirement at the time of hiring for tenure-track assistant professors. Documented interest in and experience with public engagement and community-based activities is expected. Relevant experience from a natural history museum or similar institution is an advantage.

Associate professor
Applicants at the associate professor level are expected to have a strong publication record in high-level, international, peer-reviewed venues in the area of specialization and a track record of successful external research funding. They should be a scientific specialist in one of the collection areas of the museum and have significant experience with collection-based research. Relevant experience from a natural history museum or similar is expected. Curatorial expertise and considerable previous experience and impact with curating and developing natural history collections is required at associate professor level. Broad experience and a compelling vision for public engagement and community-based activities is essential. Candidates are also required to have documented university-level competencies in delivering high-quality undergraduate/graduate teaching and must be able to explain and reflect upon their own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

Assessment of applicants
Assessment of applicants will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research as well as their curatorial experience and potential to curate one or more of the museum’s collections. Teaching and public engagement qualifications and experience will be considered according to career level. The overall fit for the Natural History Museum will also be considered.
Ideal applicants will have the following qualifications:

  • An outstanding reputation for high-quality research within Mammalogy
  • A record of scientific use of museum collections and/or data
  • A proven track record of interdisciplinary research
  • Scientific expertise that ensures ability to curate Mammalia collections held by the museum
  • Curatorial experience improving and developing natural history collections
  • Experience from a natural history museum or similar
  • Participation in national and international museum collaborations through organizations and programs.
  • A vision for how digital, genomic, and other new technologies will drive advances in natural history science
  • Ability to work at a strategic level
  • A track record of public engagement and creating impact beyond academia
  • Experience working on museum exhibitions, interpretation, and/or public engagement
  • Experience in fundraising and ability to attract research funding from external sources for research, digitization and collection development.
  • Supportive and collaborative people skills and commitment to an inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity and respect for everyone with equality and opportunity for all
  • A passion for the vision and values of the Natural History Museum Denmark
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Confidence in ability to provide advocacy for the museum with multiple stakeholders
University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor/associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.
For tenure-track assistant professors
For associate professors

Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

Information on the tenure-track programme
The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period, tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

About the Natural History Museum Denmark
The Natural History Museum Denmark is the Danish national museum for nature. We work to empower citizens to connect with nature with the aim to create positive change for people and planet. We want to inspire, engage, and enable people to enjoy, understand, and care for the diversity of the natural world. The impact of climate change and anthropogenic forces on biodiversity has reached a critical point. We firmly believe that natural history museums can and should play a key role towards a more sustainable relationship with nature. We are opening a new Danish national museum for nature in spring 2027. One big museum site, in the Botanical Garden, in the centre of Copenhagen, will host state-of-the-art laboratories, outstanding research collections, new public galleries, and combined facilities for programming, education, and citizen science. It is an ambition for the museum to enhance natural history and inspire curiosity, knowledge, and empowerment for the future. The Botanical Garden was founded in 1600, and the museum’s collections date back to Ole Worm’s Cabinet of Curiosities from around 1620. With 14 million preserved specimens and living plants of 8,000 different species in the Botanical Garden, it is the largest museum collection in Denmark. It covers our planetary history with botanical, zoological, and geological specimens from all over the world. Read more about the Mammalia collection here.

The Natural History Museum Denmark is part of the University of Copenhagen, which was founded in 1479 and is the largest university in Denmark. Read more about the museum here.
Inquiries about the position can be made to Museum Director Nina Rønsted (e-mail: nronsted@snm.ku.dk).

Affirmative action
The Natural History Museum Denmark is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, or disabled status. We are actively promoting a strategy to improve the gender balance among scientific staff. Copenhagen is a highly diverse and international Scandinavian capital with a green profile. Education is free and childcare is subsidized. Public transport is well developed, and most Copenhageners take their bike to work. There are lots of green areas in and around Copenhagen, the water in the harbor is clean enough for swimming, and the city has multiple museums and other cultural venues.

Terms of employment
Employment is as tenure-track assistant professor/associate professor according to the collective agreement or job structure under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The successful applicant is expected to take Danish lessons if there is no prior knowledge of Danish language. The International Office at the University of Copenhagen can help.
This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package for up to 2,500,000 DKK that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPHs extensive support for international researchers here

How to apply
The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW.

Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include

  • A cover letter stating the motivation for applying (1 page)
  • Research profile: description of previous, current and future research plans (3 pages)
  • Curatorial area, experience, vision, and interests (1 page)
  • Curriculum vitae documenting:
    • Previous positions at museums, universities, or other research or cultural institutions
    • Fundraising experience
    • International network and relations
    • Curatorial experience (curation of collections)
    • Public engagement activities, i.e. citizen science projects, exhibitions, popular lectures or other relevant activities
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc- and MSc-students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Diplomas (MSc and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship please include

  • A cover letter stating the motivation for applying (1 page)
  • Research profile: description of previous, current and future research plans (3 pages)
  • Curatorial area, experience, impact, vision, and interests (1 page)
  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is November 2 2026 23:59 GMT +1.

After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorised recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. We work thoroughly with this process. Several professionals from different fields must be involved. Therefore, we will not be ready for interviews until February 2027.

You can read about the recruitment process here.

Please refer to the following no. in future communication: 211-0260/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor and Curator of Mammals/211-0765/26-2E Associate Professor and Curator of Mammals

jobs.title: Service Desk Specialist
jobs.description:
**We are now looking for an IT Service Desk Specialist** to join our international IT team. This is a hybrid role, requiring presence at our Tornio site approximately 50% of the working time.

**About the role** The IT Service Desk is an essential part of Outokumpus global IT ecosystem. Our team supports employees around the world, resolves technical challenges and helps ensure that the tools and services people rely on every day work reliably.

**As an IT Service Desk Specialist**, you will provide first-line support to users who need help with hardware, software, access rights, networks and other IT-related services. Your work may involve resolving an issue affecting an individual user or contributing to the resolution of incidents with a wider impact on our critical production operations. You will collaborate daily with local and global expert teams. Together, you will solve issues, identify root causes and continuously improve our services.

**What you will do**

- Act as the first point of contact for users seeking technical support via chat, service portal, phone or email

- Investigate and resolve IT issues remotely, gathering the required information for further investigation when needed

- Advise and guide users in the use of IT services and digital tools

- Escalate unresolved issues, or those requiring deeper expertise, to the appropriate support teams

- Document investigations, actions and resolutions in our IT service management system

- Share user feedback and improvement ideas with internal teams to support continuous service development

- Contribute to maintaining the IT knowledge base and identify opportunities to improve ways of working and processes


**What we expect from you**

You will succeed in this role if you are a service-minded problem solver who can remain calm, even in busy or urgent situations. Curiosity and a genuine willingness to investigate, learn and explore new things are critical to success in this role. Not every issue comes with a ready-made answer, which is why we value someone who wants to understand what is causing the problem and find the right solution together with others.

**We hope you have:**

- A degree in IT or equivalent practical experience

- At least one year of experience in a Service Desk, IT support or similar role

- An interest in IT technology and a basic understanding of computer systems, mobile devices and end-user support

- Strong analytical skills and a systematic approach to problem-solving

- Basic knowledge of Windows workstations, Microsoft 365 and Active Directory user administration

- Fluent Finnish and English language skills, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to different user groups

- A customer-oriented, collaborative and responsible way of working

- A willingness to develop your own expertise and take responsibility for the continuous improvement of services


**Considered an advantage**

- Experience with ServiceNow or similar IT service management and ticketing systems

- Knowledge of the ITIL framework

- Experience from manufacturing or production environments

- Basic understanding of scripting or automation

- Swedish or German language skills


**What we offer**

We offer a meaningful role in an international environment where IT services play a central role in ensuring business and production continuity. You will be supported by a skilled team, have opportunities to continuously learn new things and help develop services that make a difference in the daily work of thousands of Outokumpu employees.

**Please apply latest: 11.10.2026. We might interview and select a candidate before the application period is over, so don't hesitate to apply early.**

jobs.title: Automation engineer, engine controls
jobs.description:
We are always on the lookout for a talent with a growth mindset – are you the one?
We are looking for a Automation engineer with a main responsibility in developing controls for our multifuel engines. The preferred location for this position is Turku, Finland but also Vaasa, Finland is negotiable. This is a temporary opportunity for 9 months. We offer a possibility to hybrid remote work.

Your role and responsibilities
As Automation Engineer you will be working in one of our controls functionality development teams. Together with the team you are responsible for end-to-end implementation of new controls.
A typical controls implementation task includes requirement gathering, modelling of the controls, development of test cases, implementation of controls and finally writing the documentation for the new control implemented. The tasks can also be adjusted based on your individual skills and interests.
Youll be working as a member in one of our development teams.
You will also interact with developers from other teams in area of engine controls.

Requirements for the position:
* M.Sc in automation engineering, process engineering or another relevant field
* Knowledge of closed loop control design
* Analytical mindset and ability to solve problems
* Open minded and eager to learn
* Excellent teamworking and communication skills
* Fluency in verbal and written English, our everyday work language is English


Qualifications/to be able to succeed in the position we expect you to have:
* Competence in the following areas:

* Matlab/Simulink programming
* C programming
* CI tools such as Atlassian and version control
* Experience from model creation for simulation purposes

* Experience in controls modelling
* Testing skills, we use Robot framework for testing
* Digital signal processing skills
* Understanding of multi-fuel engine control


Why you and us?
You are valued – as your true self. At Wärtsilä YOU matter. We value diversity and are committed in supporting inclusive work community.
Your growth is supported. We believe in continuous learning & teamwork. Wärtsilian community has your back when it comes to development opportunities – so you can develop beyond your potential.
You get to make a difference. Innovation and sustainability are important for us. Every day, we - Wärtsilians - put our hearts and minds into enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services into reality.

Contact & next steps
Please submit your application before the application deadline 24th of September 2026 through our Careers portal. Applications through email will not be considered. After submitting your application, you will receive a confirmation email.

Tehtävä on vakituinen ja osa-aikainen 20 tuntia viikossa. Työt olisi tarkoitus aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian. Työtä tehdään Sale Hämeenkadulla ja Sale Kupittaanpuistossa.

Työskentely on nopeatempoista ja vaatii kykyä hypätä työtehtävästä toiseen. Kaupassa työskentely on fyysistä, sillä liikumme päivän aikana paljon, nostamme ja siirrämme tavaraa ja olemme koko päivän jaloillamme. Työhön sisältyy myös hetkiä, jolloin työskentelet vuorossa yksin, joten edellytämmekin sinulta täysi-ikäisyyttä. Tehtävät edellyttävät valmiutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa vuoroissa kaupan aukioloaikojen mukaisesti. Sale Hämeenkatu palvelee asiakkaita ympäri vuorokauden, joten työvuoroja voi sijoittua arkeen ja viikonloppuun sekä aamu-, päivä-, ilta- ja yöaikaan. Sale Kupittaanpuistossa työvuorot sijoittuvat myymälän aukioloaikojen mukaisesti arkisin ja viikonloppuisin kello 5.30–00.10 välille.

Olet saletisti etsimämme myyjä, mikäli viihdyt sosiaalisessa ja itsenäisessä työssä, sekä toivotat tervehtimällä ja olemuksellasi asiakkaat tervetulleeksi myymälään. Vuorotyössä ilta-, yö- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustepalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1,20 € per tehty työtunti.

jobs.title: Material Coordinator
jobs.description:
Brænder du for koordinering, logistik og materialestyring? Er du struktureret, serviceminded og trives med mange kontaktflader i en dynamisk hverdag? Så er du måske vores nye Material Coordinator.

Rolle og ansvarsområder

Som Material Coordinator bliver du en vigtig del af OMC-teamet, hvor du får en central rolle i at sikre effektiv håndtering af materialer, udstyr og logistiske processer mellem offshore-installationer, varehus, indkøb, leverandører og interne interessenter.

Stillingen er på 30 timer.

Primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Håndtering og koordinering af backload-processer mellem offshore og onshore lokationer.

  • Opfølgning på leveringstider og dialog med indkøb om fremrykning af materialer.

  • Koordinering med bådtransport og varehus ved modtagelse og afsendelse af materialer.

  • Sikre hurtig returnering af lejeudstyr til leverandører.

  • Oprettelse og koordinering af serviceordrer til reparation af udstyr, herunder:

  • Assistere med lukning af Repair-ordrer for at sikre korrekt håndtering af økonomiske commitments.

  • Rådgivning og support ved spørgsmål omkring materialerouting til offshore-destinationer.

  • Sparringspartner for Unisol-teamet i forbindelse med forbedringer, fejl og optimering af SAP-processer.

  • Oprettelse af manuelle Purchase Requisitions til materialeindkøb.

  • Opfølgning på kvalitetskontrol (QC) for frigivelse af materialer i samarbejde med indkøb og leverandører.

  • Gennemføre materialegennemgang på kampagnebåde samt koordinere pick/pack-aktiviteter med planlæggere, varehus og bådpersonale.

  • Opfølgning på hasteordrer og kritiske materialebehov fra offshore.

  • Koordinering af reparationer på udstyr modtaget fra offshoreinstallationer.

  • Planlægning og koordinering af transporter via vejtransport.

 

Hvem er du?

  • Har erfaring inden for logistik, supply chain, materialestyring eller lagerfunktioner

  • Har erfaring med SAP eller tilsvarende ERP-systemer

  • Er struktureret og god til at holde overblik over mange opgaver samtidigt

  • Trives med koordinering på tværs af flere afdelinger og interessenter

  • Er løsningsorienteret og har en proaktiv tilgang til opgaver

  • Kommunikerer professionelt på dansk og engelsk, både skriftligt og mundtligt

  • Har fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhed og god kundeservice

 

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og varieret hverdag i et dynamisk miljø.

  • Tæt samarbejde med offshore, indkøb, lager, logistik og teknikere.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og stor indflydelse på arbejdsprocesser.

  • Et stærkt team med fokus på samarbejde, videndeling og kontinuerlige forbedringer.

  • Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Deltidsstilling 30 timer, med 1 ugentlig fridag i rul med resten af teamet.

Om NorSea

House of Offshore Innovation er et kontorfællesskab med både nationale og internationale virksomheder fra energiindustrien. Vi udlejer kontor- og mødelokaler og deler husets ressourcer og viden med hinanden.

NorSea Denmark er en del af NorSea Group, og er ejet af Wilhelmsen. Vi opererer Danmarks største offshore supply base. Gennem vores one-stop-shop koncept servicerer vi energisektoren med totale supply chain løsninger.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst, der hele tiden forsøger at udvikle os gennem innovation. Vores vigtigste aktiv er vores medarbejdere, og vi har det som vores mission at være Best Place to Work. Vi bor i vores nyrenoverede domicil, House of Offshore Innovation i Esbjerg. Hér tilbyder vi vores medarbejdere attraktive vilkår, herunder; personalerestaurant, fitnesslokale, aktiv personaleforening m.m.

NorSea Denmark is one of Europe’s leading suppliers to the maritime and offshore industry. The group operates 12 supply bases in the North Sea, and our base in Esbjerg is Denmark’s largest. We are part of the NorSea Group - a global provider of base operations and full service logistics solutions with 50 years of experience.

NorSea Group is owned by one of the world’s largest maritime industrial group, Wilhelmsen. As an experienced and reliable one-stop-shop, we at NorSea Denmark aim to set new industry standards for efficiency and safety. We deliver all types of logistics and base solutions to the offshore sector. With a deep understanding of our customers’ commercial interests and needs, we innovate safe and profitable solutions.

Interesseret?

Er du klar til at blive en vigtig del af forsyningskæden og sikre, at de rette materialer er tilgængelige på rette tid og sted? Så ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Har du spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte Michael Zdrinka Clausen, Warehouse Manager på michael.clausen@norseagroup.com eller +45 21946317

Ansøgningsfristen er den 9. oktober eller når den rette kandidat er fundet.

jobs.title: Tuotantotyöntekijä Kennelpakaste Oy
jobs.description:
Tuotantotyöntekijä Kennelpakaste Oy:lle Ikaalisiin – tule mukaan osaavaan ja rempseään porukkaan!

Kennelpakaste Oy on vuonna 1979 perustettu suomalainen lemmikkien raakaruokien valmistaja ja yksi Suomen pitkäikäisimmistä alan toimijoista. Yritys valmistaa kaikki raakalihatuotteensa omalla tehtaallaan Ikaalisissa. Kennelpakasteen valikoimaan kuuluu monipuolisesti raakaruokatuotteita koirille ja kissoille, ja tuotteita on saatavilla laajasti päivittäistavarakaupoissa ympäri Suomen. Kennelpakasteen koiranruoat ovat Avainlippu-tuotteita, ja yrityksen toiminnassa korostuvat kotimainen valmistus, laadukkaat raaka-aineet sekä pitkä kokemus lemmikkien raakaruokien valmistuksesta.

Haemme Kennelpakaste Oy:lle tuotantotyöntekijää Ikaalisiin monipuolisiin tuotannon tehtäviin. Tässä tehtävässä tärkeintä ei ole tietty koulutus tai vuosien kokemus tuotannosta, vaan hyvä asenne työntekoon, halu oppia uutta ja se, ettei koneiden tai käytännön tekemisen kanssa mene sormi suuhun.

Työpäivät koostuvat tuotannon erilaisista työvaiheista. Tehtäviin kuuluu esimerkiksi tuotteiden pakkaamista ja siirtelyä, raakalihan käsittelyä, tuotteiden pakastamista sekä erilaisten koneiden ja laitteiden käyttöä. Työhön perehdytetään vaihe vaiheelta, ja osaamisen karttuessa pääset tekemään laajemminkin erilaisia tuotannon tehtäviä. Myöhemmin mukaan tulee myös ERP-järjestelmän käyttöä.

Tuotanto on pitkälti automatisoitua ja työtahti on reipas. Töitä tehdään sekä itsenäisesti omalla työpisteellä että yhdessä noin kuuden hengen työporukan kanssa. Samassa hommassa ei myöskään tarvitse olla viikosta toiseen, vaan työtehtävät vaihtelevat tuotannon tarpeiden mukaan. Työtä tehdään maanantaista perjantaihin aamuvuorossa. Toivomme, että voisit aloittaa työt maanantaina 2.11.2026.


Mitä etsimme?

* Reipasta asennetta ja halua tarttua erilaisiin tehtäviin
* Jonkin verran aikaisempaa työkokemusta – sen ei tarvitse olla tuotannosta
* Valmiutta työskennellä raakalihan parissa ja tehdä käytännönläheistä työtä
* Kiinnostusta oppia käyttämään erilaisia koneita ja laitteita
* Yhteistyökykyä ja rentoa otetta työporukassa toimimiseen
* Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa


Mitä tarjoamme?

* Monipuolisen työn, jossa tehtävät vaihtelevat ja uutta pääsee oppimaan
* Kunnollisen perehdytyksen – kaikkea ei todellakaan tarvitse osata valmiiksi
* Rempseän ja huumorintajuisen työporukan
* Työajan maanantaista perjantaihin, pääsääntöisesti noin klo 7–15
* 37,5 tunnin työviikon ja jonkin verran joustoa työaikoihin
* Mahdollisuuden pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen
* Palkkauksen liha-alan TES:n mukaisesti

Työsuhde alkaa vuokratyösuhteena WorkPowerin kautta, minkä jälkeen tarkoituksena on siirtyä asiakasyrityksen omille kirjoille. Kennelpakaste Oy:n vakituisena työntekijänä pääset lisäksi osaksi yrityksen bonuspalkkausta ja saat käyttöösi E-passin sekä muut talon edut.

Toivomme, että kaikki yhteydenotot tehdään WorkPowerin kautta ja käännyt puoleemme, mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää tehtävään liittyen.

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä? Jätä hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian! Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja etenemme sopivien hakijoiden kanssa nopealla aikataululla.

Eevi Niemelä, rekrytoija

eevi.niemela@workpower.fi, puh. 040 516 9393
