jobs.title: Assistant Professor in High Frequency Switch-Mode Power Supplies
jobs.description:
The Digital and High-Frequency Electronics (DHFE) section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, based at the university campus in Odense, seeks outstanding individuals for full-time Assistant Professor positions in Power Electronics, focusing on power management for electronic and computing devices and systems. Successful applicants are expected to contribute to the development of academic programs and the research community. Applicants should have a PhD in Power Electronics or a closely related field. 

The DHFE section focuses on conducting research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communication, utilizing cutting-edge reconfigurable computing and sensors. The aim is to develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions that solve technology-related challenges in fields such as autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grid, and healthcare.

Applicants are expected to establish and maintain a research program in high-frequency power electronics and power management for computation, along with low-voltage electronic systems. The position emphasizes converter and power-management for computing platforms and resource-constrained applications, including battery-operated, energy-harvesting, mobile, autonomous, embedded, and sensor-based systems.

The section is a vital component of our Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Science, and Master of Science programs in Electrical and Electronics Engineering in Odense. Currently, the section focuses on three research fields: 1) Drones for Infrastructure Inspections and Interactions, 2) High-Frequency SMPS and power management for low-power electronic systems, and 3) Telecommunication Systems. The section has 15 academics, including professors, postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, and engineers, to support research, industrial collaboration, and educational activities, and is growing steadily.

The SDU campus in Odense contains six faculties and soon a large university hospital, creating a great concentration of academics and students facilitating interdisciplinary research and rich student life. The city of Odense is culturally rich, surrounded by a vibrant and growing robotics community, and highly livable with a green-banked meandering river cutting through the centre and attractive residential areas.

 

Job Description

The position focuses on power management for resource-constrained autonomous, mobile, and embedded electronic systems. Relevant research areas include high-frequency power conversion, battery-operated systems, energy harvesting, power management architectures, embedded control, and analog/digital control of converters. The application domain spans from ultra-low-power electronics and sensors to mobile platforms, robotics, drones, IoT devices, and power management for embedded, compact, and high-performance computing systems.

The role strengthens DHFE’s research profile at the interface between power electronics, microelectronics, embedded systems, and intelligent electronic devices. It is expected to support shared research themes across SDU, including energy-efficient electronics, autonomous systems, battery-powered platforms, sensor networks, health technology, and miniaturized or distributed devices.

The successful candidate should work constructively both with colleagues within DHFE and also with colleagues from other research units, such as SDU Microelectronics, SDU Centre for Industrial Electronics, the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, Faculty of Health (specifically Health Tech), Mechanical Engineering, and other relevant environments, translating power electronics competence into system-level contributions for electronic devices and platforms.

 

Duties

As a faculty member, you will be responsible for developing and delivering undergraduate and graduate teaching in Electronic and Electrical Engineering, with particular attention to strengthening control and power electronics within the BSc portfolio. This includes supervising students at Bachelor and Master’s level, mentoring students, integrating with the student body, and participating in education and outreach activities. Research duties include establishing an externally funded research agenda, publishing in leading journals and conferences, supervising early-career researchers, and contributing to the development of DHFE’s research environment. The candidate is also expected to contribute to external collaboration and perform service at the section, department, university, and professional levels.

 

Qualifications Required

  • The applicant should hold a doctoral degree (PhD) in Power Electronics, Electronics, or a related subject area. 

  • Demonstrated potential for teaching undergraduate and graduate courses at the university level. 

  • The applicant must have relevant research expertise in areas related to efficient and high-frequency power converters, converter control, and power management for computing or embedded electronic systems.

  • The applicant must have teaching skills that align with the content and responsibilities of the position. This includes possessing both pedagogical and professional skills essential for carrying out the tasks associated with the role. 

  • A strong track record for research fundraising is required. 

 

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Tim McRae (mcrae@sdu.dk)  or the Head of the Digital and High-frequency Electronics Section, Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, e-mail: esme@sdu.dk.  

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

  • Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must be in English and include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages). 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, describing the research, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, computational skills, etc.

  • A research plan with a focus on the development of your research line and research team. 

  • List of funded projects. 

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).

  • List of publications with the most relevant publications highlighted. 

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Up to three names and emails of researchers can provide an informed reference letter at short notice. (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included.) 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

  

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2027. The final start date will be agreed with the successful applicant.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Position in Animal Welfare Risks of Feeding Red Seaweed to Dairy Cows
jobs.description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Aarhus University, calls for applications for a full-time postdoctoral position. The two-year position is available from 1 February 2027, or soon thereafter. The position will be in the research unit Behaviour, stress and welfare (BSW).

Dairy cattle contribute substantially to agricultural greenhouse gas emissions, primarily through enteric methane production, making the identification of effective nutritional mitigation strategies an important area of research. While the feed additive Bovaer has received considerable attention for its methane-reducing effects, concerns regarding animal health and welfare have led to increasing interest in alternative solutions, including seaweed-based feed additives. The seaweed Asparagopsis spp. has shown significant methane-mitigating potential; however, its use has also raised animal welfare concerns. Consequently, there is a need to evaluate the animal welfare effects of seaweed-based feed additives.

Research tasks
  • Evaluating the effects of seaweed-based feed additives on the behaviour and welfare of dairy cattle.
  • Investigating behavioural indicators of discomfort and pain associated with feed management.
  • Validating welfare assessment measures through experimental approaches, including pharmacological interventions.
  • Contributing to scientific publications and dissemination of research results.
  • Participating in knowledge exchange activities with public authorities and industry stakeholders.
  • Contributing to teaching and supervision of students at the bachelor's, master's, and PhD levels.


Qualifications
We are seeking a candidate who has:
  • A PhD degree or equivalent in biology, animal science, veterinary science, or a related field, and research experience in animal behaviour and welfare.
  • A strong interest in strategies aimed at reducing the climate impact of dairy production through feeding management.
  • At least a basic understanding of feeding management.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate scientific research results effectively.
  • The ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a research environment.
  • For non-Scandinavian candidates, a commitment to learning Danish, including reading, writing, and speaking, is expected during the employment period.


Contact
Further information on the position may be obtained from Professor Margit Bak Jensen, phone: +4522365482, email: margitbak.jensen@anivet.au.dk

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities
  • A workplace characterized by equality and a good work-life balance, and an open discussion across different fields of research.


The candidate will have the opportunity to be trained and gain experience in:
  • Teaching and supervision of students at the BSc and MSc level through active involvement in teaching in animal science and in the veterinary science programme.
  • Research-based consultancy to authorities, where it is relevant.


Who we are
Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to solve essential societal challenges within the green transition: food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, environment, climate, health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for the research-based public sector consultancy and degree programs covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programs within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated in the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies, situated in close connection to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and good industrial and professional collaboration.

Please refer to Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (au.dk) for further information about the department: https://anivet.au.dk/en

Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, AU Viborg,
Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele, and the area of employment is Aarhus University (AU) with related departments.

Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff website: https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.



Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.



Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

jobs.description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project in renal calcium transport

 

The laboratory of Henrik Dimke, Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit at the Department of Molecular Medicine, University of Southern Denmark is seeking a highly motivated PhD student in the field of renal transport physiology. Particular emphasis will be placed on signalling through the calcium-sensing receptor and the regulation of renal calcium transport in transgenic models.

 

Research environment

The PhD student will join the laboratory of Professor Henrik Dimke in the Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit. The laboratory studies epithelial ion transport and the mechanisms that maintain calcium, magnesium, and phosphate balance, with particular emphasis on renal calcium transport, the calcium-sensing receptor, claudins, and kidney stone disease. The Research Unit focuses on innovative molecular and biomedical research related to cardiovascular and renal physiology. We offer a stimulating, international research environment where English is the preferred language at meetings and seminars. You will work in the modern NytSUND building, which is directly connected to the new Odense University Hospital and provides state-of-the-art laboratory and animal facilities. You can read more about the department and institute here.

 

Project description

The project will investigate how altered calcium-sensing receptor (CASR) signalling disrupts the endocrine and renal control of calcium homeostasis. Particular attention will be given to autosomal dominant hypocalcaemia type 1, in which excessive CASR activity suppresses parathyroid hormone secretion and promotes renal calcium loss. The project will examine the signalling mechanisms linking CASR activation to renal calcium transport and whole-body calcium balance. The successful applicant will use clinically relevant genetic models, including inducible and cell-specific transgenic approaches, together with detailed physiological characterization, molecular and biochemical techniques, and imaging.

 

Qualifications

Qualified and highly motivated candidates from all nationalities are encouraged to apply. 

 

The successful applicant must have

  • A Master's degree (Danish: kandidatgrad) or another relevant degree that concludes a research-based study programme of minimum five years’ duration at an institution of higher education. If you do not have a Master's degree, the Graduate School will make an individual assessment of your academic qualifications.

  • Good oral and written English language skills

  • you must at the time of submission have documented research experience. E.g. be the author or co-author of an article in a peer-reviewed international journal (must at least be submitted) or of a published abstract from an international scientific conference, or have worked as research assistant full time for at least 6 months (after completing your masters degree). The research experience of each applicant is individually assessed by the Graduate School.

 

The successful applicant should have

  • The ability to work independently and in a structured manner. 

  • Good collaborative and interpersonal skills. 

  • Previous experience with experimental animal work or relevant molecular and biochemical techniques, such as western blotting or immunohistochemistry, is preferred but not required.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:

Professor Henrik Dimke

Department of Molecular Medicine

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

Tel. +45 65 50 83 10 E-mail: hdimke@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• A letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

• • Contact details for at least one professional reference who may be contacted during the assessment process.


Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. References will normally be contacted only for shortlisted candidates.

Further information about the PhD-program can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. 

 

Closing date: October 12th, 2026


Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

 

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order).

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

 

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

 

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Join our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team and help ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of Replit's infrastructure that serves millions of developers worldwide. As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will bridge the gap between development and operations, implementing automation and establishing best practices that enable our platform to scale efficiently while maintaining high availability.



We are seeking Staff SREs who are passionate about building and maintaining resilient systems at scale. Your mission will be to proactively find and analyze reliability problems across our stack, then design and implement software and systems to create step-function improvements. You will design robust observability solutions, lead incident response, automate operational tasks, and continuously improve our infrastructure's reliability, all while mentoring and educating the broader engineering team to make reliability a core value at Replit.




YOU WILL:

 - Architect and Implement Observability: Design, build, and lead the implementation of comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing solutions. Create dashboards and metrics that provide real-time visibility into system health and performance, enabling proactive issue detection.

 - Define and Drive Reliability Standards: Work with product and engineering teams to define, implement, and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs). Build systems to monitor and report on these metrics, holding teams accountable and ensuring we maintain high reliability standards while balancing innovation speed.

 - Lead Incident Management and Response: Act as a senior leader during high-impact incidents, guiding the team to rapid resolution. Conduct thorough, blameless post-mortems and drive the implementation of preventative measures. Develop and refine runbooks and build automation to reduce Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR).

 - Drive Automation and Infrastructure as Code: Architect, build, and improve automation to eliminate toil and operational work. Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation using tools like Terraform or Pulumi. Create self-healing systems that can automatically respond to common failure scenarios.

 - Optimize Performance on Kubernetes: Collaborate with core infrastructure and product teams to performance-tune and optimize our large-scale cloud deployments, with a deep focus on Kubernetes, Docker, and GCP. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, implement capacity planning strategies, and reduce latency across global regions.

 - Debug and Harden Distributed Systems: Dive deep into debugging extremely difficult technical problems across the stack. Use your findings to design and implement long-term fixes that make our systems and products more robust, operable, and easier to diagnose.

 - Provide Staff-Level Guidance: Review feature and system designs from across the company, acting as a key owner for the reliability, scalability, security, and operational integrity of those designs.

 - Educate and Mentor: Educate, mentor, and hold accountable the broader engineering team to improve the reliability of our systems, making reliability a core value of the Replit engineering culture.

 - Build and Integrate: Write high-quality, well-tested code in Python or Go to meet the needs of your customers, whether it's building new internal tools or integrating with third-party vendors.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 8-10 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering or similar roles (e.g., DevOps, Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering).

 - Strong programming skills in languages like Python or Go. You write high-quality, well-tested code.

 - Deep understanding of distributed systems. You’ve designed, built, scaled, and maintained production services and know how to compose a service-oriented architecture.

 - Deep experience with container orchestration platforms, specifically Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies.

 - Proven track record of designing, implementing, and maintaining sophisticated monitoring and observability solutions (e.g., metrics, logging, tracing).

 - Strong incident management skills with extensive experience leading incident response for complex systems and demonstrated critical thinking under pressure.

 - Experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, Pulumi) and configuration management tools.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and simply and a bias toward open, transparent cultural practices.

 - Strong interpersonal skills, with experience working with and mentoring engineers from junior to principal levels.

 - A willingness to dive into understanding, debugging, and improving any layer of the stack.

 - You're passionate about making software creation accessible and empowering the next generation of builders.




BONUS POINTS:

 - Deep experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and tools.

 - Expert-level knowledge of modern observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry).

 - Experience designing and building reliable systems capable of handling high throughput and low latency.

 - Significant experience with Go and Terraform.

 - Familiarity with working in rapid-growth, startup environments.

 - Experience writing company-facing blog posts and training materials.

jobs.title: Seasonal Worker wanted with forklift certificate – for the pumpkin season 2026
jobs.description:
About Thorsbjerggaard

Thorsbjerggaard is a Danish farm specializing in the cultivation of edible pumpkins. Our products are supplied to many major Danish supermarkets and specialty stores. We also grow peas, squash, and watermelons.

All work is carried out on the farm, including cultivation, harvesting, washing, and packing.

A valid forklift certificate is an advantage and will be preferred.

The certificate must be valid for use in Europe.

Only applicants with a forklift certificate will be considered for the position.

Working Period

As soon as possible – end of March 2027

Working Hours

During warm periods, work usually starts at 5:00 a.m. and continues until around 12:00 noon. During busy periods, additional work in the afternoon may be required.

Working hours may vary depending on the weather and workload. Part-time work may occur. You will have at least one day off per week.

Language Requirements

You must be able to speak and understand English.

Wages

Monthly salary

Registered with the Danish tax authorities (SKAT)

Salary paid directly into your bank account, with a pay slip

Requirements

  • You must be at least 18 years old.

  • EU citizenship (a valid passport or national ID card is required).

  • Good physical condition, motivation, and a positive attitude.

  • Farm or harvesting experience is an advantage but not required.

  • A clean criminal record certificate from your home country.

We Expect You To

  • Be reliable and arrive on time.

  • Be flexible and willing to help wherever needed.

  • Work well as part of a team with people from different cultures.

  • Be able to communicate in English.

Accommodation

We have a campsite located on the farm, where you can rent a space in a caravan. Each caravan can accommodate up to four people.

Beds with mattresses are provided, but you must bring your own sleeping bag and bed linen.

The campsite offers access to toilets, showers, laundry facilities, shared cooking facilities (you prepare your own meals), and internet access.

The accommodation fee is all-inclusive.

The cost of accommodation in a caravan is DKK 70 per person per day. A refundable deposit of DKK 1,500 is required and will be returned if everything is left in the same condition as when you arrived.

Holiday Allowance

Holiday allowance will be transferred to FerieKonto and paid according to Danish holiday regulations.

Hygiene Rules

All hygiene regulations relating to the handling and harvesting of food products must be strictly followed. You will receive detailed instructions before starting work.

Failure to follow the hygiene rules may result in immediate dismissal without further warning.

What to Bring

  • Please remember to bring:

  • Sleeping bag

  • Warm clothing

  • Practical work clothes

  • Boots and waterproof clothing

  • Even in good weather, the plants can be very wet in the morning.

Important Documents

You must bring:

  • A valid national ID card (and passport, if possible)

  • A valid IBAN bank account in your own name

  • Documentation proving that you have health insurance in your home country

  • Tax Information 2026

  • You must bring documentation showing that you have a permanent address in your home country.

  • If you worked for us last year and have had other jobs since then, please bring documentation from your most recent employer.

  • If you are married, documentation of your marital status is required.

  • Please bring copies of all original documents, as well as English translations.

How to Apply

Please send your application and relevant documents to:

job@thorsbjerggaard.dk

If you do not hear from us within two weeks, please assume that your application was unsuccessful and that we are unable to offer you a position for 2026.

jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: OGÓLNY ZAKRES PODSTAWOWYCH OBOWIĄZKÓW:
1. Kierowanie  zespołem do spraw realizacji zadań z zakresu pomocy społecznej, organizowanie pracy podległych pracowników socjalnych oraz nadzór i kontrola nad rzetelnością, jakością i zgodnością ze stanem faktycznym i prawnym sporządzanych przez nich dokumentów.
2. Realizowanie innych zadań z zakresu pomocy społecznej wynikających z potrzeb gminy, w tym tworzenia i realizacja programów rządowych pomocy społecznej mających na celu ochronę i poprawę życia osób, rodzin i grup społecznych.
3. Prowadzenie analizy wykorzystania środków przychodzących z budżetu i innych będących w dyspozycji jednostki.
4. Kontrolowanie prawidłowości i rzetelności prowadzonych przez pracownika socjalnego rodzinnych wywiadów środowiskowych oraz ich zatwierdzanie.
5. Organizowanie udzielania świadczeń pomocy społecznej - pieniężnej, w naturze i usługach.
6. Współdziałanie w sprawach świadczeń pomocy społecznej z działem księgowości.
7. Współpraca przy opracowywaniu planów ośrodka z zakresu pomocy społecznej.
8. Nadzór nad merytorycznym i terminowym przygotowywaniem dokumentów, planowania i sprawozdawczości.
WARUNKI PRACY:
1. Pełny wymiar czasu pracy - 1 etat.
2. Przewidywany termin rozpoczęcia pracy po rozstrzygnięciu naboru.
3. Obiekt Centrum Usług Społecznych w Mikołowie przy ul. Kolejowej 2 jest przystosowany dla osób niepełnosprawnych ruchowo.
4. Praca przy monitorze ekranowym, praca w terenie.
5. Praca obarczona odpowiedzialnością, związana z samodzielnym organizowaniem pracy komórki organizacyjnej centrum.

jobs.title: MLAĐI/A PROCESNI/A RADNIK/CA
jobs.description:
Organizacijska jedinica: Proizvodnja, Postrojenje za proizvodnju AN/KAN 2 Opis poslova:
  • Sudjelovanje u primopredaji smjene s procesnim radnikom iz prethodne smjene
  • Obilazak postrojenja, očitavanje procesnih parametara, unošenje podataka u radne liste
  • Sudjelovanje u praćenju procesa proizvodnje na upravljačkoj ploči sukladno uputama za rad
  • Upisivanje rezultata dnevnih analiza javljenih iz Kontrole kvalitete
  • Informiranje smjenovođe o uočenim poremećajima i kvarovima u procesu proizvodnje
  • Poduzimanje korektivnih aktivnosti u cilju normalizacije procesa u suradnji sa smjenovođom i iskusnijim procesnim radnikom
  • Sudjelovanje pod stručnim nadzorom u rukovanju opremom na radnom mjestu u startu, normalnom radu i zaustavljanju postrojenja
  • Sudjelovanje pod stručnim nadzorom u preventivnom pregledu opreme, vizualna zapažanja
  • Uzimanje uzoraka pod stručnim nadzorom
  • Provođenje mjera integriranih sustava upravljanja Društva
  • Primjena pravila ZNR i ZOP
  • Održavanje čistoće na svom radnom mjestu
  • Određivanje pH taline amonijevog nitrata, određivanje koncentracije amonijevog nitrata i uzimanje uzoraka u trećoj smjeni pod stručnim nadzorom
  • Održavanje prohodnosti slivnih limova ispod transportera granulacijskog tornja i održavanje čistoće svih odvodnih kanala u postrojenju
  • Održavanje čistoće (prikupljanje rasutog proizvoda) svih transportera i ostalih uređaja u postrojenju
  • Pranje fluidizacijskog hladnjaka, čišćenje i pranje sita i drobilice, čišćenje i pranje sustava za povratnu frakciju
  • Uključivanje sustava za aminizaciju proizvoda pod stručnim nadzorom (čišćenje dizni, prepumpavanje amina)
  • Rukovanje kompresorom pod stručnim nadzorom
  • Sudjelovanje u obavljanju održavalačkih radova za vrijeme remonta i zastoja postrojenja te obavljanje manjih održavalačkih radova za vrijeme normalnog rada postrojenja te sudjelovanje u poslovima preventivnog održavanja po potrebi
  • Ostali poslovi po nalogu neposrednog rukovoditelja, sukladno potrebama posla, osposobljenosti i osobnim radnim mogućnostima
Uvjet:
  • SSS – strojarski, elektrotehnički ili kemijsko tehnološki smjer
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo u struci.
Traženi profil kandidata:
  • izražene organizacijske vještine
  • spremnost na timski rad
  • odgovornost i pouzdanost.
Nudimo Vam:
  • ugovor o radu na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rad 6 mjeseci
  • naknadu troškova prijevoza na posao i s posla
  • naknadu za prehranu
  • prigodne nagrade (uskrsnica, regres, božićnicu) sukladno odrebama Kolektivnog ugovora I odlukama Uprave
  • uslugu prehrane u restoranu unutar tvorničkog kruga
  • priliku za rad na raznovrsnim i zanimljivim radnim zadacima u dinamičnom poslovnom okruženju
  • mogućnosti za učenje na radnom mjestu i izvan njega.
Ako ste u navedenom radnom mjestu prepoznali izazov za svoju karijeru i udovoljavate navedenim uvjetima, prijavite se na email adresu: karijera@petrokemija.hr najkasnije do 27.9.2026. godine. Razmatrane će biti samo pravovremene i potpune prijave (životopis i dokazi o ispunjenju uvjeta) pristigle pristigle na naznačenu e-adresu. U prijavi obavezno naznačiti radno mjesto za koje se prijavljujete. Više o nama saznajte na www.petrokemija.hr

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Core DevOps
Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

Tööülesanded: Otsime oma meeskonda ostuspetsialisti, kes aitab hoida ostuosakonna igapäevatöö sujuvana ning andmed ja dokumendid korras. See amet sobib Sulle, kui naudid täpsust nõudvat tööd, suhtled hea meelega ning oskad oma tegemisi iseseisvalt korraldada. Sinu panus aitab tagada, et tootmiseks vajalik tooraine oleks õigel ajal tellitud ja oluline info jõuaks õigete inimesteni.
SINU PEAMISED ÜLESANDED ON: • lood ja seadistad kaupade andmeid infosüsteemis ning hoiad materjalide ja tarnijate info ajakohasena; • tellid koostöös vahetu juhiga toorainet, vajadusel tegeled allhangetega ning haldad ostutellimusi; • küsid tarnijatelt hinnapakkumisi, võrdled hindu ja aitad valida sobivaima lahenduse; • suhtled igapäevaselt kangatarnijatega, küsides hindu, saadavust, tarneaegu, minimaalseid tellimiskoguseid ja muid ostutingimusi; • tegeled koos kvaliteediosakonna ning tarnijatega kvaliteediprobleemide ja reklamatsioonide lahendamisega; • jälgid materjalide saadavust ja tarneid ning reageerid õigeaegselt võimalikele tarneriskidele ja puudujääkidele; • analüüsid materjalide hindu ja hinnamuutusi ning toetad ostuhindade ja kulude optimeerimist; • koordineerid kangaste proovide, värvikaartide, laboriproovide ja muude materjalinäidiste tellimist ning liikumist; • teed koostööd tootmise, planeerimise, kvaliteedi, arenduse ja müügimeeskonnaga, et tagada vajalike materjalide õigeaegne ja optimaalne saadavus; • haldad ostudokumentatsiooni ning infot tarnijate ja klientide portaalides; • aitad koostada ja ajakohastada osakonna juhendeid ning teavitad müügi- ja planeerimismeeskonda tarnetõrgetest.

Omalt poolt pakume: • stabiilset tööd rahvusvahelises ja arenevas ettevõttes;
• vaheldusrikast tööd, kus saad panustada ostuprotsessi sujuvusse ja õppida tundma rahvusvahelise tootmisettevõtte igapäevatööd; • põhjalikku väljaõpet ja toetavat sisseelamist; • toetavat ja sõbralikku meeskonda, kellega on hea ühiste eesmärkide nimel töötada; • arengu- ja koolitusvõimalusi ning ettevõtte pakutavaid hüvesid.

• oled täpne, korrektne ja vastutustundlik; • oskad oma tööd iseseisvalt korraldada ning väärtustad koostööd; • oled hea suhtleja ja naudid meeskonnas töötamist; • kasutad arvutit väga heal tasemel ning tunned end andmete ja dokumentidega töötades kindlalt; • valdad eesti keelt ning oskad inglise keeles suhelda nii kõnes kui ka kirjas; • oled omandanud vähemalt keskhariduse.

jobs.title: Senior QA Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.
Annual sports grant.
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.
Home internet.
A conditional monthly transportation grant.
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.
Relocation Package.

Please submit your application in English.

Please apply by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenriscreations.com/en/postings/d315eb37-715d-4657-b29d-484420749257
Application deadline 8th of october 2026

jobs.title: Commercial Counsel
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're seeking an experienced Commercial Counsel to join our growing legal team and serve as a strategic partner to our rapidly expanding enterprise sales organization. In this high-impact role, you'll drive complex commercial negotiations that fuel our growth, working closely with our sales teams to close sophisticated technology agreements with enterprise customers across diverse industries. You'll play a critical role in scaling our commercial legal processes while navigating the evolving landscape of AI-powered development tools and ensuring our customers can confidently deploy Replit's platform in their organizations.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Drive Enterprise Deals: Serve as the lead legal advisor for complex, high-value enterprise sales transactions, working directly with our Account Executives and customer legal teams to negotiate and close sophisticated software agreements

 - Navigate AI & Technology Compliance: Help enterprise customers understand and navigate the legal and regulatory implications of adopting AI-powered development tools, addressing data privacy, security, and compliance requirements across various industries

 - Build Scalable Frameworks: Design and implement contract playbooks, template agreements, and streamlined processes that enable our sales team to move quickly while maintaining legal rigor as we scale

 - Risk Management: Identify, analyze, and proactively manage complex commercial and legal risks while maintaining deal velocity in our fast-paced, high-growth environment

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Security, and Privacy teams to ensure our commercial offerings align with product capabilities and regulatory requirements

 - Strategic Advisory: Provide strategic guidance to leadership on commercial legal matters, emerging AI regulations, and market trends affecting developer tools and enterprise software adoption

 - Customer Relationship Building: Foster strong relationships with enterprise customer legal teams, becoming a trusted advisor who helps facilitate smooth adoption of Replit's platform




YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - Legal Foundation: JD from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar

 - Commercial Experience: 5-7 years of relevant legal experience supporting enterprise software sales and complex commercial transactions, preferably at high-growth technology companies

 - Technology Focus: Strong background in SaaS agreements, software licensing, and technology transactions, with bonus points for experience with AI/ML tools, developer platforms, or cloud infrastructure

 - Deal Velocity: Proven track record of successfully closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals in fast-paced environments while balancing legal risk with business objectives

 - Business Acumen: Exceptional business judgment and ability to provide practical, solutions-oriented legal advice that enables (rather than blocks) commercial success

 - Communication Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with experience presenting to and influencing C-level executives and enterprise customer stakeholders

 - Startup DNA: Thrives in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments where you'll need to build processes from the ground up and adapt quickly to changing priorities

 - Collaboration: Collaborative mindset with a track record of building strong cross-functional relationships and supporting high-velocity sales processes




BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

 - In-House Experience: Previous in-house counsel experience at technology companies, particularly those serving enterprise customers or developer audiences

 - AI/Developer Tools: Experience with AI, machine learning, or developer platform companies, including understanding of the unique legal considerations around code generation and AI-assisted development

 - Industry Knowledge: Experience working with enterprise customers in regulated industries or understanding of compliance requirements across different sectors

 - Scale Experience: Experience supporting sales teams through hypergrowth phases, including building legal processes that scale with rapid revenue expansion

jobs.title: Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique (H/F)
jobs.description:
Barcelone - Espagne
Rejoindre le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique capable de suivre les projets de manière autonome, de coordonner les différents intervenants et de contribuer au développement commercial du groupe.
Votre mission
En lien direct avec la Direction, les équipes techniques et les partenaires du groupe, vous prenez en charge le suivi des affaires depuis l'analyse du besoin client jusqu'à la coordination de la réalisation.
Votre rôle consiste à faire le lien entre les clients, les bureaux d'études, les équipes commerciales, les partenaires techniques et les unités de production afin de garantir le bon déroulement des projets.
Ce poste est basé à Barcelone, avec une activité tournée principalement vers le développement et le suivi des affaires en France et sur les autres marchés du groupe.
Vos principales responsabilités
Suivi des affaires et coordination technique
- Analyser les demandes clients, les dossiers techniques, plans et cahiers des charges ;
- Participer à l'étude de faisabilité technique et commerciale des projets ;
- Préparer, suivre et relancer les offres commerciales ;
- Coordonner les échanges entre clients, bureaux d'études, partenaires techniques et équipes internes ;
- Suivre l'avancement des projets, les délais, les priorités et les points de blocage ;
- Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction ;
- Veiller à la bonne transmission des informations nécessaires à la production et à la réalisation des projets.
Développement commercial et relation partenaires
- Développer et entretenir un portefeuille de clients et partenaires ;
- Représenter AXOR auprès des acteurs du secteur : entreprises, bureaux d'études, architectes, maîtres d'œuvre, partenaires industriels ;
- Identifier de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires sur les marchés ciblés ;
- Participer à la structuration des méthodes commerciales et du suivi client ;
- Contribuer au développement des activités liées aux structures métalliques, à l'enveloppe du bâtiment et aux solutions constructives.
Profil recherché
- Expérience confirmée en chargé d'affaires, conduite de projets, développement commercial BTP, construction métallique, ingénierie ou environnement similaire ;
- Bonne compréhension des dossiers techniques, plans, métrés, chiffrages et contraintes chantier ;
- Capacité à piloter plusieurs affaires en parallèle avec rigueur et autonomie ;
- Aisance dans la relation client, la négociation et la coordination d'interlocuteurs variés ;
- Esprit entrepreneurial, sens de l'organisation et capacité à structurer son activité ;
- Profil terrain, réactif, fiable et orienté solutions ;
- Une expérience dans la construction métallique, le bâtiment industriel, l'enveloppe du bâtiment ou les structures métalliques serait fortement appréciée.
Langues
- Français courant indispensable ;
- Espagnol professionnel indispensable ;
- Anglais apprécié ;
- Turc apprécié.
Ce poste s'adresse à vous si..
En plus d'une solide compréhension technique et commerciale, nous recherchons une personne capable de prendre en main des affaires de manière autonome, de sécuriser le suivi des projets et de contribuer concrètement au développement du groupe.
Cadre de la collaboration
- CDI ou collaboration selon profil ;
- Poste basé à Barcelone ;
- Déplacements ponctuels à prévoir en France et auprès des clients / partenaires ;
- Rémunération selon profil et expérience.

jobs.title: Junior kampagne specialist for Google Ads i Barcelona
jobs.description:
Er du klar til at forlade Danmark og det regnfulde vejr til fordel for den livlige, spændende og smukke by Barcelona? Og kunne du tænke dig at tilføje værdifuld arbejdserfaring med Google Ads til dit CV? Så er dette måske noget for dig!

Barcelona er hjemsted for mange store kunstnere og malere, så der er altid masser af kunst at udforske. Byens mest berømte kulturelle mesterværk er Gaudís værk, den imponerende katedral "Sagrada Familia," som repræsenterer en unik stil inden for moderne arkitektur.

Hvis du ikke er så vild med kunst og kultur, kan du tilbringe dagen på en af Barcelonas sandstrande, som kun ligger en kort gåtur fra byens centrum. Her kan du nyde noget af det bedste middelhavsinspirerede seafood. Byen har et ry for at være den mest kosmopolitiske, moderne og fremsynede by i Spanien. Selvom det er en meget moderne by, finder du stadig de gamle kvarterer som det gotiske kvarter, hvor byens ældste bygning ligger, samt utallige barer og butikker.

Vi tilbyder

  • Konkurrencedygtig lønpakke og bonussystem

  • Udviklingsmuligheder inden for virksomheden

  • En arbejdsplads med gode kolleger, sociale arrangementer og et kontor med havudsigt

  • Relocation-pakke (Betalt fly til Barcelona og den første måneds husleje betalt + økonomisk bolig støtte din anden måned)

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Gratis fitnessmedlemskab

  • Præstationsbonusser

Om jobbet:

Som junior kampagne- og marketingspecialist vil du være ansvarlig for at forbedre og udvikle kampagner. Derfor vil du skulle rådgive og have gode forhandlingsevner – det er ikke aggressivt salg, men det er vigtigt, at du besidder nogle salgsmæssige kvaliteter. Dit daglige arbejde vil inkludere opgaver som:

  • Fungere som en betroet konsulent og onboarde kunder

  • Udvikle PPC-kampagner

  • Forstå kundernes behov og mål

  • Ansvar for at øge forbrug, mersalg og bæredygtighed

  • Håndtere en stor mængde potentielle kunder dagligt via telefonopkald

Dine kvalifikationer

Du taler dansk på modersmålsniveau og er flydende i engelsk (B2).

Erfaring: Minimum 1-2 års erfaring inden for salg og/eller online annoncering. Erfaring med outbound-opkald og salg (ikke påkrævet). BA/BS i Marketing, Digital Marketing eller Kommunikation er et plus.

Du har en god forståelse og et solidt niveau af computerfærdigheder.

Fremragende problemløsningsevner med evnen til at finde og identificere de rette oplysninger. Du har erfaring med og en passion for online display-annoncering.

Stærke kommunikations- og forhandlingsevner. Du er serviceorienteret, professionel og grundig.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at sende en mail til Cll@jobsqd.com


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Prentari / Printer
jobs.description:
Prentmet Oddi leitar að ábyrgðarmiklum, nákvæmum og metnaðarfullum starfsmanni til að sinna starfi prentara.
Um er að ræða fjölbreytt og krefjandi starf í öflugu framleiðsluumhverfi þar sem gæði, þjónusta og fagmennska eru í fyrirrúmi.

Helstu verkefni:
Stýra og hafa umsjón með offsetprentvél.
Úttekt og samanburður prófarka og prentarka til að tryggja gæði framleiðslu.
Umsjón með viðhaldi véla og útfylling viðhaldsbókar.
Veita svör og ráðgjöf varðandi prentun og tæknileg atriði.
Umhirða og frágangur vinnuaðstöðu.
Önnur tilfallandi verkefni tengd starfssviðinu.

Hæfniskröfur:
Reynsla af offsetprentun eða sambærilegri framleiðslu er kostur.
Góð tæknileg þekking og hæfni til að vinna sjálfstætt.
Nákvæmni, skipulagshæfni og öguð vinnubrögð.
Jákvætt viðhorf og góð samstarfshæfni.
Áhugi á gæðum og stöðugum umbótum.

Launakjör fara eftir reynslu, þekkingu og hæfni umsækjanda.
Starfið fellur undir kjarasamning Grafíu.
Vinnutími er frá 08:00 til 16:00 virka daga, en til 15:30 á föstudögum.

Um Prentmet Odda:

Prentmet Oddi er stærsti framleiðandi landsins á kartonumbúðum, almennu prentverki og bókum. Félagið vinnur jafnframt með mörgum af öflugustu umbúðaframleiðendum Evrópu til að veita fyrirtækjum heildarlausnir á sviði umbúða. Prentmet Oddi þjónustar meginþorra af kröfuhörðustu fyrirtækjum landsins og hefur gert það í áratugi með hraða, gæði og persónulega þjónustu að leiðarljósi.

Áhugasamir umsækjendur eru hvattir til að sækja um starf á:

🔹 https://alfred.is/starf/prentari-oskast-6

eða

🔹 https://www.prentmetoddi.is/prentmet-oddi/atvinnuumsokn

Nánari upplýsingar má einnig fá með því að senda fyrirspurn á isi@prentmetoddi.is.

Við leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur metnað fyrir gæðum, tæknilega færni og áhuga á að taka þátt í framleiðslu á fyrsta flokks prentverkefnum.
Umsóknarfrestur er til og með 12 september 2026

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Prentmet Oddi is seeking a responsible, detail-oriented, and motivated Offset Printer to join our production team.
This is a varied and challenging position within a dynamic manufacturing environment where quality, service, and professionalism are key priorities.

Key Responsibilities:
Operate and oversee offset printing presses.
Inspect and compare proof sheets and printed sheets to ensure production quality.
Perform routine machine maintenance and maintain maintenance records.
Provide guidance and answer questions regarding printing processes and technical matters.
Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
Carry out other related duties as required.

Qualifications:
Experience in offset printing or a similar production environment is an advantage.
Strong technical aptitude and ability to work independently.
Excellent attention to detail and organized work practices.
Positive attitude and strong teamwork skills.
Commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

Salary will be based on the applicant's experience, knowledge, and qualifications.
Employment terms are governed by the collective agreement of Grafía (The Icelandic Printing and Media Union).
Working hours are 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, Monday through Thursday, and 8:00 AM to 3:30 PM on Fridays.

Prentmet Oddi is Iceland's largest producer of carton packaging, commercial print products, and books. The company also collaborates with some of Europe's leading packaging manufacturers to provide comprehensive packaging solutions for businesses. For decades, Prentmet Oddi has served many of Iceland's most demanding companies, with a strong focus on speed, quality, and personal service.

🔹 https://www.prentmetoddi.is/prentmet-oddi/atvinnuumsokn

📧 isi@prentmetoddi.is

jobs.title: Pædagogisk assistent til vuggestue
jobs.description:
Børnehytten søger en dedikeret pædagogisk assistent til vores vuggestue.

Hvem er vi: 

Vi er en privat integreret daginstitution beliggende i hjertet af Kettinge. Vi er normeret til 12 vuggestuebørn og 29 børnehavebørn. Vi har tæt samarbejde med forældrebestyrelse og det lokale forenings- og forretningsliv.

Huset rummer nærhed, omsorg og sammenhold for børnene såvel som for kollegaerne. Vi har fokus på trivsel og tryghed og vægter derfor bl.a. forældrekontakten højt. Vi er gode til at arbejde sammen og spille hinanden gode i hverdagen. Grundet husets størrelse er der en naturlig god relation til børnene på tværs af stuerne og vi kan hurtigt træde til på alle stuer, hvis behovet opstår. 

Børnehytten støder op til en tidligere grusgrav, der nu fungerer som rekreativt område med bålhytte, naturlegeplads, kunstige søer med fisk og mange andre muligheder for udfoldelser med børnene. Derudover har vi vores egen legeplads der er opdelt i vuggestue og børnehave, hvor vi prioriterer at børnene kommer ud hver dag. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du nyder at være en del af udelivet uanset vind og vejr, da vores børn også elsker at hoppe i vandpytter, kigge på biller og finde regnorme.

I vuggestuen er værdien af tid central for vores pædagogiske arbejde. Tid til nærvær, tid til fordybelse og tid til at skabe små betydningsfulde øjeblikke der danner fundamentet for børnenes læring, udvikling, trivsel og dannelse. Vi har fokus på at skabe udviklende læringsmiljøer, hvor alle børn – uanset behov og forudsætning -har mulighed for at deltage i meningsfulde fællesskaber.

Vi forventer af dig:

Du er uddannet pædagogisk assistent og gerne med erfaring fra dagtilbudsområdet. Du er empatisk, omsorgsfuld og vægter arbejdet med relationer højt. Du er nysgerrig og legende i din tilgang til børnene og vægter tid, tillid og tryghed højt hos både store og små.

Du skal have en naturlig interesse og nysgerrighed på sproglig udvikling og brugen af det i hverdagen.

Du kan i samarbejde med dine kollegaer på stuen, planlægge aktiviteter og evaluere disse med udgangspunkt i den nye styrkede pædagogiske læreplan.

Du kan samarbejde med din kollegaer, om at vurdere børnenes trivsel og udvikling og ved behov iværksætte konkrete tiltag. Du skal kunne se det enkelte barn og bidrage til at udarbejde handleplaner, indstillinger, koordinere tværfagligt samarbejde med mere.

 

Om stillingen:

Vi tilbyder en ansættelse hurtigst mulig eller fra 1/11-26 i en 32 timers stilling efter gld. overenskomst.

Ansøgningsfrist: 23/9-26 Samtaler forventes afholdt i uge 40.

Send din ansøgning og CV til leder@boernehytten.dk

 

Kontakt gerne leder: Tinni eller souschef Stine - 53841514 - Man-Fredag kl. 9-15, for mere information.

Auto Dobrovolný je rodinná firma s více než 30letou tradicí. Máme přes 90 zaměstnanců ve třech provozovnách – Velké Meziříčí, Jihlava a Znojmo – a silné servisní zázemí. Zastupujeme značky Škoda, Opel, MG a LEAP motor a nabízíme stabilní zaměstnání, férový přístup a smysluplnou práci.

Do naší pobočky v ŠKODA v Jihlavě hledáme zkušeného nebo začínajícího parťáka, nadšence do osobních aut, který ocení moderní vybavení dílny a je otevřen novým technologiím, které automobilky v oblasti elektromobility nabízí. Hledáme člověka, který se nebojí nových výzev a je otevřen se učit novým technologiím. Pokud Vám někde chybí zkušenosti – vše doučíme. Důležité je, aby Vás práce bavila a byl na Vás spoleh.

•    Práce s řídicími jednotkami, elektronikou, asistenty, senzory a dalšími systémy.

•    Spolupráce s kolegy v moderním servisním zázemí a koordinace oprav.

•    Manuální zručnost a schopnost pracovat samostatně i v týmu.
•    Technické myšlení, pečlivost a spolehlivost.
•    Nadšení do aut, touha učit se nové technologie (hybridy, elektro).

Co nabízíme

•    Příspěvek na obědy

jobs.title: PROJEKTANT SURADNIK/PROJEKTANTICA SURADNICA
jobs.description:
PROJEKTANT SURADNIK (m/ž)

Za rad u projektantskom uredu tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za radno mjesto Projektant suradnik (m/ž).

Opis posla

Projektant suradnik sudjeluje u izradi arhitektonskih projekata kroz različite faze projektiranja, u suradnji s glavnim projektantom i ostalim članovima projektnog tima.

Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • sudjelovanje u izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata

  • izradu i razradu arhitektonske projektne dokumentacije

  • izradu tehničkih nacrta, detalja i grafičkih priloga

  • sudjelovanje u razvoju projektnih rješenja

  • usklađivanje projektne dokumentacije s ostalim strukama

  • pripremu dokumentacije za ishođenje potrebnih dozvola i suglasnosti

  • komunikaciju i koordinaciju s kolegama, suradnicima i ostalim sudionicima u projektu

  • praćenje projekta i izvršavanje zadataka prema dogovorenim rokovima

  • sudjelovanje u obilascima lokacija i gradilišta prema potrebi

Uvjeti i očekivanja

Od kandidata očekujemo:

  • završeno odgovarajuće obrazovanje iz područja arhitekture, graditeljstva ili srodnog tehničkog područja

  • poznavanje rada u relevantnim programima za projektiranje i izradu tehničke dokumentacije

  • preciznost, odgovornost i organiziranost

  • sposobnost timskog rada i kvalitetne komunikacije

  • samostalnost u izvršavanju povjerenih zadataka u skladu s razinom iskustva

  • spremnost na učenje i profesionalni razvoj

Radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima je prednost, ali razmotrit ćemo i kandidate s manje iskustva koji pokazuju znanje, motivaciju i želju za učenjem.

Mjesto i način rada

Rad se obavlja na licu mjesta, u prostorijama projektantskog ureda.

Tražimo osobu koja će biti svakodnevno prisutna u uredu i aktivno sudjelovati u radu projektnog tima. Ovo radno mjesto nije predviđeno za rad na daljinu (remote) niti isključivo online suradnju.

Što nudimo

  • rad na raznovrsnim arhitektonskim i projektantskim zadacima

  • rad u profesionalnom i suradničkom okruženju

  • mogućnost učenja i razvoja stručnih znanja

  • sudjelovanje u svim fazama razvoja projekta

  • stabilnu i dugoročnu suradnju

  • mogućnost profesionalnog napredovanja u skladu sa znanjem, iskustvom i rezultatima

Ako ste zainteresirani za rad u projektantskom uredu i želite biti dio tima koji zajednički razvija i realizira projekte, pozivamo vas da nam pošaljete svoj životopis i, ako je primjenjivo, portfolio dosadašnjih rad

jobs.title: Senior Controller
jobs.description:
Senior Controller

Work tasks: As part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in the areas of packaging, biomaterials and wooden construction, as well as one of the world’s largest privately owned forest owners. We believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future.
Our company employs approximately 19,000 people. Our global Finance Operations unit handles accounting activities and provides financial services across a range of areas. In the world of finance, we value accuracy, collaboration and innovation. Career for a better climate. Every day. Your Responsibilities as a Senior Controller Act as a Finance Business Partner for a business area/business unit, legal entity or group function. Lead or support controlling and financial reporting processes for the entity/function within your area of responsibility. Be responsible for the effective and accurate period-end closing, analysis and reporting activities of the entity/function. Contribute to and support the implementation and management of an efficient and accurate forecasting and budgeting process within the entity/function. Represent the entity/function in queries related to other Finance Operations processes, including Record to Report (RtR), Purchase to Pay (PtP) and Order to Cash (OtC). Ensure the implementation and compliance with Stora Enso’s financial processes and policies within the entity/function. Proactively identify opportunities for improvement, make recommendations and lead changes to continuously improve and harmonise end-to-end controlling processes. Lead and support process automation and other development projects. Ensure close collaboration and effective information flow between the entity/function, the Finance department and key stakeholders across other functions. Support and train stakeholders on controlling-related topics. What We Expect from You A Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in controlling, management reporting or accounting. A good understanding of controlling processes, including period-end closing, operational financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and management reporting. Good knowledge of controlling tools and analytics platforms, such as Excel, SAP, OneStream and Power BI. Experience in leading process improvement and harmonisation initiatives. A change-oriented mindset – you are willing to improve processes, develop new ways of working and promote standardisation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail and quality. The ability to work in a matrix organisation and in an international environment. Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence others and explain complex financial information to people who are not finance specialists. Very good command of English, both spoken and written.

We offer: By joining us, you will become part of an organisation with a diverse and inclusive work culture that supports you in discovering new perspectives and developing professionally.
You will contribute to a more sustainable world, as we believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future. To help you perform your work safely and feel well, we support both your physical and mental wellbeing. This is a permanent position with an open-ended employment contract. How to Apply You can submit your application to us only in English, using our recruitment system. We hope to receive your application as soon as possible, but no later than 24 September. If you have any questions, please contact our People and Culture representative, Alena Stesnerova, at alena.stesnerova[at]storaenso.com.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Software Engineer, User Database Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

You’ll build the systems that let any knowledge worker leverage fast, scalable databases without having to become a DBA.

You’ll be a hands-on technical leader, helping set the architectural direction and roadmap as we take a new product from early alpha to general availability. You’ll work directly with early customers to shape foundational technical and product decisions. Then, together, we’ll work on scaling as adoption and workloads grow.

This is a backend-leaning role with work spanning the stack. You might build the systems that provision and manage a fleet of customer Postgres instances, design how user-defined schemas evolve safely, or make complex queries execute efficiently. You’ll also follow those systems into the product: improving how a table loads, how users understand a slow operation, or how an agent safely works with their data.

You’ll help shape the architecture and the product together. Some problems call for a better abstraction, others for a better default, and others for rethinking what we ask the user to do in the first place. You’ll work with teammates and customers to find those answers, ship practical solutions, and evolve them as usage grows.



Our stack includes Postgres, Go, TypeScript, Node.js, and React.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

The people who understand a business best aren’t always the people who can build its software. A support lead knows how tickets should be triaged. An operations manager knows how inventory should move. But turning that knowledge into a reliable system often means finding an engineer, provisioning a database, and building an application.

We’re building database infrastructure for everyone else. We want everyday knowledge workers to bring their data into Notion, connect it, and build workflows around it. And do so with the power of a real database (Postgres!) and the approachability of a tool they already know.

AI agents make that opportunity even bigger: helping people build and operate systems they couldn’t have created on their own.

For our team, this is much more than putting a friendly interface on Postgres. It means making hard database problems disappear from the user’s workflow without sacrificing correctness, performance, or flexibility. How do you let someone reshape a live database as easily as editing a document? Make the right indexes exist without asking someone to become a DBA? Let a weekend experiment grow into a company’s system of record without anyone having to rearchitect it?




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Take a new product from alpha to general availability. Work with early customers to understand what matters, iterate on feedback, and help shape what we ship.

 - Make real customer workloads fast. Improve query execution, indexing, and client data loading so performance holds up as datasets grow and workflows become more demanding.

 - Build systems businesses can trust with their data. Make schema changes, concurrent writes, permissions, and recovery reliable enough for customers to build essential workflows on top.

 - Make powerful capabilities approachable. Turn database provisioning, migrations, and indexes into a reliable, easy-to-use product experience that gives people the power of a database without the burden of managing one.

 - Build for the customers who come next. Automate database provisioning and fleet operations, strengthen observability, and evolve the architecture so we can serve many, many customers.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Production relational database experience (e.g., Postgres or MySQL). You’ve made decisions about schemas and indexes, analyzed database performance, and debugged issues involving transactions, locking, or concurrency. Your experience goes beyond accessing a database through an ORM.

 - Engineering experience and technical leadership. You bring 10+ years of experience building and operating production software, with a track record of setting technical direction and leading complex, cross-team initiatives from concept through delivery. You identify the most important problems to solve, turn ambiguous goals into a technical strategy, and align engineers and partner teams around a practical plan. You stay hands-on while helping others make better decisions through design reviews, mentorship, and clear technical guidance.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals. You’ve built services that need to remain correct under concurrency and failure. You can reason about retries, partial failures, consistency, and the trade-offs involved in reliable reads and writes.

 - A systematic approach to performance. You use query plans, traces, profiles, and experiments to find bottlenecks and verify improvements. You’re willing to follow a problem across storage, services, and client code rather than stopping at a team boundary.

 - Product judgment. You’re interested in who will use what you build, not just how it works. You can turn a customer’s problem into a technical approach and recognize when a better default or simpler workflow would solve it more effectively.

 - Willingness to work across the stack. You bring backend depth, but you’re comfortable learning unfamiliar systems and working in client code when that’s what delivering a good experience requires.

 - Fluency with AI-assisted engineering. You use AI to accelerate exploration, implementation, and testing while taking responsibility for understanding and validating the result.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience managing fleets of databases or building database platforms, including provisioning, upgrades, backups, and recovery.

Kilsaran Paving and Walling requires multiple Maintenance Fitter roles for their premises at Piercetown, Dunboyne, Meath, A86W820. Relevant electrical trade certifications and experience working in a manufacturing or heavy production environment are preferred.
