#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Service Technician and Installation Supervisor - Denmark
jobs.description:
About the position:
Ferrum is looking for an experienced and hands-on Service Technician and Installation Supervisor who can take responsibility for the installation, start-up and servicing of individual machines and complete filling lines at our customers' sites. We supply solutions for the production and filling of beer and soft drinks, including process equipment, filling machines, conveyors and associated utility systems.

You will have a key role at customer sites, combining hands-on work with the coordination of installation, connection, testing and commissioning activities. The position requires solid industry experience and extensive travel. Assignments will mainly be in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe, and you must be prepared for overnight stays, changing working hours and work carried out during production shutdowns.

Your main responsibilities:
- Plan and carry out the installation, mechanical assembly and run-in of new machines and complete filling lines.
- Act as Installation Supervisor and coordinate Ferrum technicians, customer personnel, subcontractors and other equipment suppliers on site.
- Ensure correct positioning, levelling and mechanical integration of machines, conveyors, piping, platforms and associated equipment.
- Carry out and verify pneumatic connections and assist with the connection of process media and utilities such as compressed air, water, CO2, nitrogen, steam, cooling and CIP.
- Participate in testing, FAT/SAT, commissioning, production start-up and performance runs in close cooperation with project management, automation specialists and the customer.
- Systematically troubleshoot mechanical and pneumatic faults and carry out basic fault-finding on electrical signals, sensors, drives and PLC-related issues.
- Perform service, inspections, preventive maintenance, repairs, modifications and format changeovers on existing systems.
- Identify the root causes of downtime and quality issues and recommend spare parts, maintenance activities and technical improvements.
- Train customer operators and maintenance personnel in safe operation, cleaning, changeovers and routine maintenance.
- Document progress, working hours, deviations, outstanding items and completed work in daily site and service reports.
- Ensure that all work is performed safely and in accordance with applicable safety requirements, customer site rules and relevant hygiene and food-production requirements.
- Provide practical feedback to the project, engineering and service teams to support the continuous improvement of future solutions and installations.

Your professional background:
- You have a relevant technical qualification, for example as an industrial mechanic, marine engineer, metal fabricator, automation technician or similar.
- Extensive relevant industry experience may compensate for a different educational background.
- You have several years of hands-on experience with the installation, servicing and commissioning of machinery or complete lines for the beverage, brewery, food or packaging industry.
- You have in-depth knowledge of filling lines and preferably experience with fillers, cappers, can seamers, conveyors, mixers/carbonators, pasteurisation, CIP and utility equipment.
- Experience from a manufacturer or service organisation such as Krones, KHS, Sidel, GEA or another supplier of process and filling lines would be a clear advantage.
- You are able to read and work from mechanical drawings, layouts, P&IDs, pneumatic diagrams, manuals and technical documentation.
- You have strong mechanical expertise and can perform precise alignment, installation, adjustment and systematic troubleshooting.
- Knowledge of electrical systems, instrumentation, variable frequency drives, sensors and Siemens PLC/HMI systems is an advantage, but this is not a dedicated PLC programming role.
- You can communicate professionally in written and spoken English. Danish or another European language would be an advantage.
- You hold a valid driving licence and a valid EU/EEA passport, and are able to travel and work throughout Denmark and Europe without significant restrictions.

Personal qualities:
- You take ownership of your assignments and maintain an overview, even when schedules are tight or several disciplines are working simultaneously.
- You are hands-on, solution-oriented and comfortable working independently away from the office.
- You communicate clearly and respectfully with customers, colleagues and subcontractors and can lead site meetings in a professional manner.
- You work in a structured manner and follow up on agreements, open items, safety, quality and documentation.
- You are flexible regarding travel, working hours and changing priorities and understand that start-ups and production-critical service assignments may require additional effort.

We offer:
- A permanent position with significant influence on the successful delivery of international customer projects.
- A varied working day involving new installations, commissioning, service and technical problem-solving.
- The opportunity to work with complete solutions - from process systems and utilities to the finished filling line.
- Close cooperation with project managers, engineers, automation specialists, suppliers and customers' technical organisations.
- An informal company with short decision-making paths, a high level of responsibility and a strong focus on quality and professional integrity.
- Salary and employment terms based on qualifications, together with relevant travel conditions and work equipment.

Practical information:
- Work location: Ferrum's base in Fredericia, combined with assignments at customer sites in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe.
- Travel: Extensive and varying according to the project portfolio. Overnight travel and assignments lasting several weeks may occur.
- Employment: Permanent position.

Application:
Please send your application and CV, including a brief description of your experience with filling lines, installation, service and commissioning. Please also state which machine types and suppliers you have previously worked with and the level of travel you are accustomed to.

For more information about the position and application process, please visit: https://workindenmark.jobnet.dk/find-job/3d290357-17fd-4f50-9711-71a9b19dd200

jobs.title: Senior People & Culture Partner
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Impact Fund Denmark has changed a lot in a short time. We have grown quickly, welcomed many new colleagues and are becoming a larger, more international investment organisation. The same goes for People & Culture and we need and experienced People & Culture professional to strengthen our deliveries in the next phase.

The next phase is about making that growth work well: helping teams come together, strengthening leadership and building and implementing people practices that are robust enough for a more complex organisation without becoming unnecessarily heavy.

We are looking for a senior People & Culture professional with a proven track record across the full HR agenda, including culture and organisational development. You will bring experience and judgement that strengthen the whole function, with the ambition and potential to be considered for the Head of People & Culture role within three to four years. We also welcome experienced former Heads of People & Culture who want to contribute at this level as an individual contributor.

You will serve the whole organisation, where you will partner closely with senior leaders on organisational, leadership, performance and people questions. You will also take responsibility for selected People & Culture priorities and projects across Impact Fund Denmark.

You will be a senior sparring partner to the Head of People & Culture and Executive Management, bringing the confidence and experience to challenge established thinking, shape our people strategy and lead its implementation. We expect you to contribute expertise that colleagues across People & Culture, including its leadership, can learn from.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

What you’ll be working on

A part of your role will be spent working directly with leaders across our investment organisation. The questions will vary: how a team should be structured, what capabilities we need next, how to address and build performance, how we strengthen succession, or what senior management needs to know before making a people decision.

You will:

  • lead culture and organisational development initiatives, translating our values and strategic priorities into everyday leadership behaviours, stronger collaboration and clear accountability for performance

  • advise senior leaders and Executive Management on organisational, capability, performance and complex people matters across headquarters and regional offices

  • prepare analysis, recommendations and decision material for Executive Management and, when relevant, the Board

  • support organisational and job design as teams, mandates and responsibilities evolve

  • advise on employee relations matters within local employment law and our agreements across headquarters and regional offices

  • use people data to identify patterns, challenge assumptions and support better decisions

  • take ownership of selected People & Culture projects that cut across the organisation

  • work with People Operations, Finance and Legal to ensure that people processes have clear approvals, appropriate controls and traceable documentation, supporting compliance and auditability under the Danish standards on public-sector auditing (SOR)

  • work closely with colleagues in Recruitment, People Operations and People Development, and coach and mentor People & Culture colleagues to strengthen their business partnering skills and prepare them for broader responsibilities

We are currently a relatively lean People & Culture function. That means there is not a specialist team to hand work over to. If a recommendation requires analysis, a presentation, a new process or careful implementation, you should be comfortable taking ownership and doing that work yourself.

What a good first year looks like

After your first year, we would expect that:

  • Change has moved beyond discussion and design. You have taken ownership of important organisational or capability priorities and helped turn them into practical improvements.

  • Core processes work well. Performance, talent and compensation processes in your area are consistent, useful and delivered on time. Leaders can explain and document their decisions, and demonstrate that people resources are used responsibly and effectively in a state-owned organisation.

  • Leaders trust your advice and judgement. Senior investment leaders involve you early as a trusted advisor and challenger when important organisational or people questions arise.

  • Decisions are better supported. Executive Management receives clear, well-argued recommendations and useful People material from you.

What we’re looking for

There is no single background that will make someone successful in this role, but you will need substantial experience dealing with the full People & Culture agenda, strategy and policy work, senior stakeholders and an organisation that has really great people and leaders with massive potential.

We would expect you to bring:

  • substantial experience in a broad senior HR Business Partner, People Partner or People leadership role in international organisations

  • experience advising senior executives directly on organisational and people decisions

  • demonstrated experience across the full HR agenda, including people strategy, culture and organisational development, recruitment, leadership development, performance, talent and succession, reward, employee relations and HR governance

  • practical experience with organisational design and complex employee matters

  • strong analytical skills and an ability to turn complicated information into a clear point of view and useful recommendations

  • evidence that you can take work from diagnosis through to implementation rather than relying on large specialist teams

  • solid knowledge of Danish employment law and HR practice; knowledge of local employment law across our regional offices is considered an advantage

  • professional fluency in Danish and English

It would be useful, but is not essential, if you also have experience with one or more of the following:

  • financial services, investment or another complex, knowledge-intensive organisation.

  • working with Executive teams and Boards or preparing material for Executives and Board discussions

  • international HR

  • a lean or smaller organisation where senior People professionals remain in delivery

  • compensation, People Analytics, talent or succession

Where the role sits

This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports.

You will be the main People & Culture partner for our investment organisation, working directly with senior investment leaders. At the same time, you will own selected priorities that matter across Impact Fund Denmark and work closely with the Head of People & Culture.

The role will suit someone who likes that combination: being in the room for senior discussions, then staying close enough to the work to make sure something actually happens afterwards.

You should be comfortable moving between an Executive Management discussion, detailed analysis and the practical conversations needed to implement a decision.

Why join Impact Fund Denmark?

You will have close access to the Head of People & Culture and senior leaders across our organisation. You will have considerable scope to influence how we organise, lead and develop our people as Impact Fund Denmark grows and consolidates.

You will also be joining at a point where the organisation is evolving. We are building the people foundation for a larger and more professional international investor, which means some things are already well established while others still need to be shaped.

And the organisation's purpose is tangible. Our investments support green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries.

Practical details

  • Location: Østbanegade 135, 2100 Copenhagen Ø

  • Position: Permanent, full-time, 39 hours per week including lunch

  • Hybrid working: We currently have up to 20% of working time from home starting after 6 months of employment. We believe being in office is important for successful onboarding and integration into team and organisation.

  • Application deadline: 23 September 2026

  • Please apply through our talent platform. Applications submitted outside the platform will not be considered.

  • We review applications on an ongoing basis.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Impact Fund Denmark has grown over the past few years, and many of our colleagues are still relatively new to the organisation. In 2027, our focus is on making that growth work well: strengthening the systems, processes and ways of working a larger organisation needs, while continuing to hire for our ambitions toward our 2027-2030 strategy.

Recruitment is an important part of that next phase.

We are creating a dedicated Senior Talent Acquisition Partner role to take ownership of how recruitment works across Impact Fund Denmark from attraction and sourcing to assessment, candidate experience and offer.

Hiring managers make the final hiring decision. Your role is to make sure they reach it through a strong, well-run and well-informed process.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

What you’ll be working on

You will own end-to-end recruitment across the organisation, covering both investment roles and corporate and support functions.

For each hire, you will take the process from the first conversation with the hiring manager through to offer. You will be responsible for keeping the process moving, maintaining a high standard and making sure both candidates and hiring managers know what to expect.

At the same time, you are responsible for anchoring the recruitment process in the organisation, training hiring manager or appointed recruitment panel, and meticulous documentation of the hiring process and decisions to ensure compliance.

That includes:

  • advising hiring managers on role definition, the candidate market and the right recruitment approach

  • delivering a professional and engaging candidate journey from start to finish, including a welcoming, seamless and positive on-site experience for arriving candidates

  • coordinating, overseeing and driving end-to-end recruitment processes in close collaboration with hiring managers

  • sourcing directly, mapping relevant markets and reaching out to candidates who may not be actively looking

  • Identifying, sourcing and vetting talents on different channels to find top-tier active and passive candidates, and conduct initial screening interviews to assess technical and interpersonal-skills as well as cultural alignment

  • screening and interviewing candidates and helping managers design structured, relevant assessments

  • managing timelines, expectations and communication from intake through to offer

  • briefing and managing external search or recruitment partners when we use them

  • setting and ensuring a consistent standard for job ads, interviews, candidate communication and hiring documentation

  • building talent pipelines and market knowledge for recurring or difficult-to-fill profiles

  • using recruitment data to improve hiring quality, timeliness and cost-effectiveness, and demonstrate responsible use of recruitment resources in a state-owned organisation

  • improving our recruitment tools, templates and ways of working over time

  • ensuring that selection criteria, candidate assessments, approvals and hiring decisions are clearly documented and traceable, supporting public-sector governance, compliance with applicable rules and internal policies, and auditability under the Danish standards on public-sector auditing (SOR)

  • contributing to selected People & Culture projects alongside recruitment where it makes sense

  • training and guiding hiring managers on recruitment processes and guidelines to drive fair, consistent hiring decisions

We use Talentech as our applicant tracking system and CatalystOne as our HR system.

What a good first year looks like

After your first year, we would expect that:

  • Recruitment has a clear owner. Hiring managers know where to go for advice and support, and there is a consistent professional standard across the organisation.

  • Processes are stronger and more consistent. Roles are well defined, assessments are structured, and recruitment decisions are properly documented.

  • Hiring processes keeps moving. Managers receive relevant, well-screened candidate fields, and processes keep momentum on the factors within your control.

  • We rely less on who happens to apply. Direct sourcing is used actively where needed, and external search partners are brought in selectively and managed closely.

What we’re looking for

This role needs someone who is comfortable owning recruitment rather than simply coordinating it.

You will need to bring:

  • Solid experience independently managing end-to-end recruitment

  • strong direct-sourcing experience, including outreach to passive candidates

  • experience recruiting into a professional, knowledge-intensive environment

  • confidence advising senior and demanding hiring managers

  • the ability to keep recruitment processes moving and hold people to agreed timelines

  • experience screening and interviewing candidates, with good judgement about assessment quality

  • strong structure, follow-through and attention to the documentation behind hiring decisions

  • professional fluency in Danish and English

It would be useful, but is not essential, if you also have experience with one or more of the following:

  • recruiting investment or financial-services professionals

  • executive search or other senior professional recruitment

  • briefing and managing external search or recruitment partners

  • market mapping, talent intelligence or proactive pipeline building

  • using recruitment data and metrics to improve processes

  • international recruitment

Where the role sits

This is a Lead role with no direct reports. You will have full ownership of the recruitment lifecycle, meaning you should be comfortable balancing high-level strategy and manager coaching with hands-on execution, including the day-to-day administrative and coordination tasks, candidate care and operational execution.

You will be the main point of contact for recruitment across Impact Fund Denmark and the person responsible for how recruitment is run and for its quality.

Hiring managers remain accountable for who they hire. You bring the candidate market knowledge, recruitment expertise and process that help them make those decisions well.

That means being willing to challenge a brief when necessary, being realistic about the market, keeping a process moving when other priorities compete for attention, and making sure candidate experience does not become an afterthought.

For specialist searches, or during periods of particularly high hiring activity, you will also work with HRBP colleagues and external search partners. For periods of low activity you will build adjacent HR capabilities and part take in leadership development,....

Why join Impact Fund Denmark?

You will have the opportunity to shape how recruitment is done across the organisation rather than inherit a narrowly defined part of the process.

You will work closely with the Head of People & Culture and with senior leaders across the organisation, including our investment teams.

The role is unusually broad for an internal recruitment position. One search may be for an investment professional with a highly specialised background; the next may be for a corporate or functional expert.

And the work connects directly to Impact Fund Denmark's purpose. Every person you help bring into the organisation contributes, in some way, to investments in green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries.

Practical details

  • Location: Østbanegade 135, 2100 Copenhagen Ø

  • Position: Permanent, full-time, 39 hours per week including lunch

  • Hybrid working: Up to 20% of working time from home

  • Application deadline: 23 September 2026

  • Hybrid: We currently have up to 20% of working time from home starting after 6 months of employment. We believe being in office is important for successful onboarding and integration into team and organisation.

Please apply through our talent platform. Applications submitted outside the platform will not be considered.

We review applications on an ongoing basis.

Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. jobs.title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

At Damia Group Portugal (Permanent)Portugal
Expires at: 2027-05-12
Remote policy: Full remoteAbout the company: Damia Group is an international tech recruitment agency with 3 decades of experience. Our arrival in Portugal, 7 years later, was set on a mission to transform IT recruitment experiences and, through them, achieve better results. We believe in long-term relationships with a transparent and relaxed mindset. In a short period, we have reached the hearts of both scale-ups and larger organisations by delivering spot-on curated candidate shortlists, increased job offer acceptance rates and shorter time-to-fill.

Main requirements

Role OverviewThis is a senior, hands-on role for someone who views Data Infrastructure as a product.You will define how billions of records are structured, indexed, and exposed to the rest of the company. Ideal for someone who combines strong backend engineering skills with deep expertise in data platforms, data lakes, and large-scale data systems. Key Responsibilities

-
Database Reliability & Scaling:

- Own the health and performance of their core databases.
- Own and optimize their MongoDB clusters and OpenSearch indexes, which houses billions of documents. You will design sharding strategies and indexing patterns to ensure search performance.
- Design and implement a multi-tier storage strategy. You will determine which data remains "hot" in production databases for their Product team and which data is offloaded to "cold/analytical" storage for AI and R&D.
-
Data Access Layer:

- Build and maintain internal APIs that allow internal teams to build features without worrying about the underlying database complexities.
-
Schema Evolution & Migrations:

- Lead the strategy for updating data structures across billions of records. You will design "no-downtime" migration paths for their production MongoDB and OpenSearch environments.
-
Data Platform & Architecture

- Own and evolve their Core Data Architecture, ensuring it supports analytics, product features, AI workflows, and internal consumption.
- Evaluate the feasibility and ROI of introducing a Data Lakehouse architecture for long-term storage and AI training.
- Define standards for how data is ingested, stored, versioned, and exposed to downstream systems.
-
Data Quality & Documentation:

- Ensure data accuracy, freshness, and consistency through validation and testing.
- Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation of pipelines, schemas, and data assets to enable internal adoption.
-
Collaboration:

- Act as a bridge between Core, Product, and R&D, ensuring research initiatives (e.g. data enrichment) are integrated into the Core platform.
- Translate business and product needs into scalable, maintainable data solutions.
- Comfortable working in async-first environments, keeping task statuses and documentation up to date for full team visibility.

What They're Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in Backend, Data Engineering and/or Data Platform roles, specifically within high-concurrency/high-volume environments.
-
NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

-
Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.
- Tax residency in Portugal.

Kvaliteedi tagamine: Ühtsete teenindusstandardite kehtestamine ja kõrgete reitingute hoidmine. Innovatsioon ja automatiseerimine: Tööprotsesside optimeerimine, kasutades kaasaegseid tööriistu (PMS, Make.com, AI lahendused). Strateegiline koostöö: Koostöö müügi- ja raamatupidamisüksusega KPI-de jälgimiseks ja hinnastamisstrateegiate elluviimiseks.

Omalt poolt pakume: Mõjuvõimas roll: Te ei ole lihtsalt mutrike süsteemis, vaid inimene, kes kujundab kogu operatiivset infrastruktuuri.
Tehnoloogiline eelis: Otsene kokkupuude hotellinduse tipptehnoloogia ja AI-lahendustega. Motiveeriv tasu: Konkurentsivõimeline põhipalk, millele lisandub tulemustasu vastavalt eesmärkide täitmisele. Arengukeskkond: Toetav juhtkond ja ambitsioonikas meeskond kasvavas ettevõttes.

jobs.title: People Analytics & Rewards Specialist
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
As Impact Fund Denmark continues to grow and professionalise, we want more of our people and organisational decisions to be grounded in evidence, data and a clear understanding of what drives behaviour and performance.

That is why we are creating a new role at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent.

You might already work in HR and be looking to build deeper analytical expertise. Or you may come from organisational psychology, economics, analytics or a related field and want to apply your skills in a People & Culture setting.

Either way, what matters most is that you are curious about how organisations work, comfortable working with data, and able to turn analysis into useful insights and practical recommendations and that you take pride in contributing and getting things to impact.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Your role is to help us understand our organisation better — and use that understanding to make better decisions.

Your work will span analytics, reward and talent. You will:

  • Analyse employee, performance, engagement, talent and compensation data

  • Turn data and research into clear conclusions and practical recommendations for People & Culture and management

  • Support compensation benchmarking and our annual salary and compensation processes

  • Contribute to the implementation of the EU Pay Transparency requirements, including the related analysis and reporting

  • Develop dashboards, recurring People reporting and metrics that help us focus on what matters

  • Analyse engagement survey results and help turn them into meaningful organisational actions

  • Support talent, succession and performance processes with analysis and insight

  • Bring relevant research from organisational psychology and behavioural science into the way we design and evaluate People initiatives

  • Challenge assumptions and help us understand whether our interventions are having the intended effect

  • Prepare clear presentations and decision material for colleagues and leadership

  • Contribute to selected organisational development and talent projects

YOUR FIRST YEAR

By the end of your first year, we would expect to see progress in five areas:

  • Data: our People reporting and analytics are clearer, more consistent and more useful

  • Reward: compensation processes are supported by reliable analysis and relevant market data

  • Listening: employee survey data is translated into meaningful insights rather than simply reported

  • Evidence: important People initiatives increasingly have a clear evidence base, purpose and intended outcome

  • Decision support: People & Culture and leadership receive concise, relevant analysis that helps them make better decisions

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This is what we need to see:

  • A relevant academic background, for example in psychology, organisational psychology, economics, business, HR, statistics or another analytical discipline

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills

  • A few years of relevant professional experience. We care more about the quality and relevance of your experience than an exact number of years

  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with data

  • The ability to move from data or research to a clear conclusion and a practical recommendation

  • Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding why People practices work — rather than simply following established practice

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Professional fluency in English

These would be advantages, but they are not requirements:

  • Previous HR experience

  • Experience with Compensation & Benefits or Reward

  • Experience with People Analytics, employee surveys or HR reporting

  • Knowledge of statistics or research methodology

  • Experience with Power BI or similar visualisation tools

  • Experience applying organisational psychology or behavioural science in an organisational setting

  • Emotional intelligence, active listening and the ability to stay neutral under pressure

  • Courage to address uncomfortable issues, strong mediation and conflict-resolution capability

  • Professional fluency in Danish

WHERE THE ROLE SITS

This is an individual-contributor role within People & Culture.

You will work closely with the Head of People & Culture and with colleagues responsible for People Partnering, Operations and Recruitment.

Your role is to bring analytical depth and an evidence-based perspective to the areas where it can improve our decisions — particularly Reward, Talent, engagement and organisational development.

The scope is intentionally broad enough for you to grow and develop, but the professional core is clear: using data and evidence to improve people and organisational decisions.

WHY JOIN US

This is an opportunity to:

  • Help build a new capability at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent

  • Work closely with the Head of People & Culture and colleagues across the function

  • Apply data, research and behavioural science to real organisational questions

  • Build broad experience across compensation, talent, engagement and organisational development

  • Work in an organisation where the People agenda connects to a wider purpose: our colleagues support investments in green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries

PRACTICAL DETAILS

  • Location: Østbanegade 135, 2100 Copenhagen Ø

  • Position: Permanent, full-time, 39 hours per week including lunch

  • Hybrid: We currently have up to 20% of working time from home. We aim for first 6 months of employment to be in office for successful onboarding and integration into team and organisation.

  • Application deadline: 23 September 2026

Please apply through our talent platform. Applications submitted outside the platform will not be considered.

We review applications on an ongoing basis.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark

jobs.title: Technical Sales Support Engineer to EYKON, Denmark or Mälardalen, Sweden
jobs.description:
EYKON operates as an independent utility infrastructure technology company built on more than 130 years of utility expertise. Headquartered in Switzerland, with a network of expert local teams, the company serves customers in more than 75 markets and supports over 100 million connected endpoints across the region.

Combining proven metering technology, deep utility expertise and real-world operational insight from one of the largest installed bases in EMEA, EYKON connects what utilities measure with how they operate. This helps customers gain greater visibility, make better decisions, maintain greater control and unlock more value from the infrastructure they already operate.

Do you want to play a key role in the green energy transition while working in the intersection of technology, customer support and commercial development?

EYKON is looking for a Technical Sales Support Engineer to support customers and sales activities across Scandinavia. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, coordinating stakeholders and solving a wide variety of customer and business challenges in an international environment.

In this role, you will become a central part of the Scandinavian organisation. Acting as the link between customers, sales teams, product management and technical specialists, you will help ensure that customers receive the right support while contributing to the continued growth of the business across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

The Role

As Technical Sales Support Engineer, you will support Scandinavian customers and the Nordic Sales organisation across EYKON's portfolio of hardware, software and service solutions. The role combines customer support, pre-sales, order management and stakeholder coordination in a truly international environment.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Supporting customers across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.
    Coordinating customer-related activities and acting as the customer's internal ambassador.
    Working in close cooperations with order management team
     Following up on logistics, deliveries and customer commitments.
    Providing technical and commercial support to the sales organisation
    Supporting tenders, RFQs and commercial projects.
    Participating in pre-sales initiatives and customer-facing activities.
    Conducting customer, market and competitor analysis.
    Coordinating activities between customers and internal specialists.
    Supporting customer training, product documentation and knowledge transfer together with Training team och Product Management.

This is a highly collaborative role where your ability to build relationships and navigate different stakeholder groups will be just as important as your technical understanding. You will work closely with experienced specialists while gradually developing extensive knowledge of EYKON's products, solutions and customers.

The preferred location is Sorø, Denmark, but strong candidates located in Sweden, particularly in the Örebro/Mälardalen region, will also be considered. Travel within Scandinavia is included in the role.

Is this you?

To be successful in this role, you have experience from a customer-facing B2B environment involving technical sales, customer support, sales support, application support, pre-sales or similar technical-commercial responsibilities. You are comfortable working with technical products, systems or solutions and enjoy building strong relationships with both customers and internal stakeholders. Experience coordinating activities across multiple functions and stakeholders is important, as is the ability to support quotations, tenders and customer-related projects. You understand how hardware, software and services interact within a broader solution environment and are able to translate technical topics into practical customer value. Professional proficiency in English together with Swedish and/or Danish language skills is required in the role, as the position involves daily collaboration with colleagues and customers across Sweden, Denmark and Norway.

Experience from the energy sector, utilities, smart metering, infrastructure, automation or related technical industries is considered an advantage, but we welcome candidates from a broad range of technical and technical-commercial environments. The most important factor is your ability to learn, build relationships and create value for customers.

In this recruitment, your personal qualities will be of great importance. We are looking for a proactive, structured and customer-focused person who enjoys taking ownership and driving activities forward. You are curious, eager to learn and comfortable operating in the intersection between commercial and technical discussions. As a person, you enjoy creating structure, coordinating stakeholders and ensuring that things get done. You thrive in collaborative environments and are motivated by building relationships, solving problems and supporting both customers and colleagues.

Do you want to know more?

jobs.title: Team Leader Nurse Team

Are you an inspiring leader who wants to make a difference every day?

At Viking Travel Care, we help travellers who become ill or injured while abroad. From our offices in Torrevieja and Fuengirola, Spain, we provide travel and medical assistance services 24/7, 365 days a year to customers and travellers worldwide.

We are now looking for a Team Leader for our Medical Assistance Coordinator (Nurse) team.

Our Nurses are experienced Registered Nurses from the Nordic countries. They assess medical reports, coordinate treatment, communicate with healthcare providers around the world, handle own medical cases, and support travellers during some of life's most challenging moments. They also serve as an important medical resource for colleagues across the Travel Care operation.

As Team Leader, you will have day-to-day personnel responsibility for a team of highly skilled nurses, supporting their development and helping ensure that the Medical Assistance team works in a structured, professional, and reliable way.

You will work closely with Viking Travel Care's Medical Management and Operations Management teams, as well as fellow Team Leaders, to support the continued development of our medical assistance services. In this role, you will act as an important link between the Medical Assistance team and management, helping translate strategic priorities into daily operations, quality improvements, and employee development.

This is a unique opportunity to combine healthcare expertise with people leadership in an international and fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

    Personnel responsibility for a team of Medical Assistance Coordinators (nurses)
    

    Conduct performance reviews, development conversations, and regular follow-up meetings
    

    Drive employee engagement, professional development, and competence building within the team
    

    Support recruitment, onboarding, and training of new team members
    

    Ensure delivery of agreed service levels, KPIs, and quality standards
    

    Monitor workloads, staffing, and operational priorities
    

    Support daily operations and assist with complex cases when needed
    

    Handle administrative responsibilities such as scheduling, absence follow-up, and workforce planning
    

    Promote high clinical and documentation standards
    

    Ensure compliance with SOPs, routines, and quality requirements
    

    Support the implementation of new processes, routines, and quality initiatives within the Medical Assistance team
    

    Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and cross-functional projects across Travel Care

Qualifications Required

    Experience from healthcare, medical assistance, travel assistance, insurance, customer service, operations, or another relevant field.
    

    Fluent in one of the Nordic languages and English
    

    Strong communication and interpersonal skills
    

    Comfortable working in a dynamic and international environment
    

    Strong IT skills and ability to quickly learn new systems
    

    Clean criminal record

Preferred

    Relevant experience in people leadership, team coordination, employee development, or similar responsibilities.
    

    Registered Nurse holding a valid nursing licence recognised within the EU, with a minimum of three years of clinical nursing experience
    

    Experience from travel assistance, insurance medicine, emergency care, intensive care, ambulance services, acute care, or similar fields

What can we offer the right candidate?

    Competitive salary and employment conditions
    

    Permanent employment contract under Spanish labour law
    

    Employer-provided laptop and mobile phone
    

    Comprehensive onboarding and training programme
    

    A supportive and collaborative work environment with highly skilled colleagues
    

    Social activities and team events
    

    Modern offices in Torrevieja and Fuengirola
    

    The opportunity to work in an international organisation helping travellers worldwide

Are you the one we're looking for?

The right person for this position is a positive and approachable leader who enjoys helping others succeed. You thrive in a dynamic environment, balancing operational priorities with employee development. You are organised, solution-oriented, and focused on creating clear and reliable ways of working for your team. You enjoy working closely with others while also taking ownership and acting independently when needed.

Most importantly, you believe that great customer care starts with strong teamwork, professional judgement, and clear, friendly communication.

About Viking

Viking Assistance Group is a leading roadside and travel assistance company in the Nordics. Viking Travel Care is the group’s travel and medical assistance division, providing assistance services 24 hours a day, 365 days a year to travellers and employees abroad. Across our services, we aim to make assistance easy to access, reliable in delivery, and friendly in every interaction.

Workplace

As soon as possible.

GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.

jobs.description:
Diamond Slice — General Manager (Fuldtid / Full-time)

Arbejdssted / Location: Blågårds Plads & Tagensvej, 2200 København N

Stillingstype / Position: Fastansættelse, fuldtid / Permanent, full-time

Ansøgningsfrist / Deadline: Snarest muligt / As soon as possible

Sprog / Languages: Dansk & Engelsk (se nedenfor / see English version below)

DANSK VERSION

General Manager — Diamond Slice, København (Nørrebro)

Trives du i en tempofyldt gæstfrihedskultur, elsker du surdejspizza på højeste niveau, og har du den operationelle rygrad til at drive et hurtigtvoksende restaurantbrand?

Siden åbningen på Blågårds Plads har Diamond Slice redefineret New York-style pizza i København. Med to velbesøgte kvarter-lokationer på Nørrebro (Blågårds Plads og Tagensvej 79), en voksende cateringforretning og et markant fodaftryk på Roskilde Festival og sommerevents, søger vi nu en skarp og handlekraftig General Manager.

Som General Manager leder du forretningssiden af Diamond Slice. I tæt parløb med vores Operations Manager og teamledere etablerer du solide systemer, driver FOH-performance og sikrer, at vores lokationer kører gnidningsfrit, effektivt og selvkørende.

Nøgleområder og ansvarsopgaver

  • Forretningsdrift & systemer:

    • Drive den daglige forretningsdrift på tværs af lokationer i tæt parløb med vores Operations Manager.

    • Opbygge, optimere og fastholde pålidelige faste rutiner, systemer og ansvarsfordeling i teamet.

    • Styre bestillingsrutiner, lager og vareoptælling samt træde til og dække for vores Operations Manager ved behov.

    • Opdage flaskehalse i tide og eksekvere praktiske løsninger proaktivt.

  • FOH-ledelse & gæstfrihed:

    • Lede, sparre med og inspirere FOH-medarbejdere og skifteledere.

    • Have det fulde ejerskab over FOH-vagtplanlægning og sikre, at lønmålene konsekvent overholdes.

    • Rekruttere, onboarde og oplære teammedlemmer til Diamond Slices servicestandarder.

    • Håndtere gæstefeedback, kundehenvendelser og daglig kommunikation.

  • Catering, festivaler & vækst:

    • Koordinere indkomne cateringforespørgsler og eventlogistik med Operations Manager og eventteamet.

    • Tage det operationelle ejerskab over Diamond Slices festivalsetups (herunder Roskilde Festival), inklusiv frivillige, bemanding og logistik.

    • Drive lokal forretningsudvikling, samarbejder og community-aktiveringer.

  • Økonomistyring & rapportering:

    • Følge op på det daglige salg, lønomkostninger og dækningsgrader for at identificere optimeringsmuligheder.

    • Klargøre ugentlige løn- og performancerapporter forud for ledelsesmøder.

    • Rapportere drift, bemanding og strategiske forslag løbende til ejerkredsen/bestyrelsen.

Hvem vi søger

  • Dokumenteret erfaring: 2+ års ledererfaring fra tempofyldt restaurationsdrift (f.eks. som General Manager, Assistant GM eller Operations Manager).

  • Systemer & tal: Erfaring med vagtplansystemer, POS/lagerstyring og med at holde lønprocenter inden for budgettet.

  • Hands-on ledelse: Du går forrest under travlhed, bevarer roen under pres og sætter en høj standard for gæstfrihed.

  • Sprog: Professionelt niveau i engelsk er påkrævet (internationalt team). Dansk på samtale- eller flydende niveau er en klar fordel ift. lokal administration og leverandørdialog.

Hvad vi tilbyder

  • En definerende lederrolle i et af Københavns mest anerkendte pizzakoncepter.

  • Reelt mandat og indflydelse på virksomhedens processer, teamkultur og forretningsvækst.

  • En støttende og sammentømret teamkultur med høj energi og stort fokus på håndværket.

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn efter kvalifikationer samt personalegoder.

  • En fleksibel arbejdsplan.

Ansøgning

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning til work@diamondslice.dk med emnet "General Manager — [Dit Navn]".

ENGLISH VERSION

General Manager — Diamond Slice, Copenhagen (Nørrebro)

Do you thrive in high-energy hospitality, love sourdough pizza made at the highest level, and bring the operational backbone to run a fast-growing restaurant brand?

Since opening on Blågårds Plads, Diamond Slice has redefined New York-style pizza in Copenhagen. With two bustling neighborhood shops in Nørrebro (Blågårds Plads and Tagensvej 79), an expanding catering wing, and a major footprint at Roskilde Festival and summer events, we are looking for a sharp, driven General Manager.

As General Manager, you will lead the business side of Diamond Slice. Working in close partnership with our Operations Manager and team leaders, you will establish solid systems, drive FOH performance, and ensure our shops run smoothly, efficiently, and autonomously.

Key Focus Areas & Responsibilities

  • Business Operations & Systems:

    • Drive day-to-day business operations across locations alongside the Operations Manager.

    • Build, streamline, and maintain dependable daily routines, systems, and team accountability.

    • Oversee ordering schedules, inventory, and stock control; step in to cover for the Operations Manager when needed.

    • Spot bottlenecks early and execute practical solutions proactively.

  • FOH Leadership & Hospitality:

    • Lead, mentor, and inspire Front of House staff and shift leaders.

    • Own FOH rota management and ensure labor targets are consistently met.

    • Recruit, onboard, and train team members to Diamond Slice's service standards.

    • Handle guest feedback, inquiries, and daily customer communications.

  • Catering, Festivals & Growth:

    • Coordinate incoming catering requests and event logistics with the Operations Manager and event team.

    • Take operational ownership of Diamond Slice’s festival setups (including Roskilde Festival), including volunteers, staff, and logistics.

    • Drive local business development, collaborations, and community activations.

  • Financial Control & Reporting:

    • Monitor daily sales, labor costs, and operational margins to identify efficiency gains.

    • Prepare weekly labor and performance summaries for leadership meetings.

    • Report regularly on operations, staffing, and strategic proposals to the ownership group/board.

What We Are Looking For

  • Proven Track Record: 2+ years of management experience in high-tempo hospitality (e.g., General Manager, Assistant GM, or Operations Manager).

  • Systems & Numbers: Experience managing scheduling tools, POS/inventory setups, and keeping labor percentages on budget.

  • Hands-on Leadership: You lead by example during rushes, bring calm energy under pressure, and set high hospitality standards.

  • Languages: Professional working proficiency in English is required (international team). Conversational or fluent Danish is a strong advantage for local administration and supplier coordination.

What We Offer

  • A defining leadership role in one of Copenhagen’s most celebrated pizza concepts.

  • Real autonomy and influence over company processes, team culture, and business growth.

  • A supportive, close-knit team culture with great energy and high craftsmanship.

  • Competitive salary matching qualifications, and company perks.

  • A flexible schedule.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter to work@diamondslice.dk with the subject line "General Manager — [Your Name]".

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Mission of the role

To ensure the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of payroll for multiple UK clients. The UK Payroll Executive will be responsible for managing payroll data, processing payroll transactions, supporting workplace pension auto-enrolment, responding to client queries, and ensuring all payroll activities are completed in line with UK labour laws, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and agreed client timelines.

The role requires strong attention to detail, client service, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple payrolls and deadlines efficiently while continuously looking for ways to improve workflows through technology, AI, and automation.

Key outcomes In the first 6â12 monthsOutcome 1: UK Payroll Knowledge & Process Proficiency

Become fully familiar with Sleek's internal payroll platforms and processes, including HMRC submissions such as RTI, FPS and EPS, workplace pension submissions, and year-end reporting requirements including P60s and P11Ds by the third month.

Outcome 2: Accurate & Compliant Payroll Processing

Process assigned client payrolls accurately and within agreed timelines, ensuring all payroll data is complete and correctly validated before submission.

Ensure 100% compliance with agreed payroll and statutory deadlines, including payroll runs, pension auto-enrolment submissions, and applicable HMRC requirements.

Identify discrepancies or potential issues early, take ownership of resolving them, and maintain high standards of confidentiality and data accuracy.

Outcome 3: Client Service & Responsiveness

Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to payroll-related queries.

Consistently achieve a CSAT target of at least 97% month-on-month while ensuring that client queries and emails are responded to within the agreed communication SLA, with no non-reply tickets or emails left unresolved at the end of the working day.

Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear updates, proactively following up on outstanding information, and handling difficult conversations positively when required.

Outcome 4: Team Collaboration & Process Improvement

Work effectively with the UK Payroll team and other internal departments to ensure smooth payroll operations and timely resolution of client or processing issues.

Contribute to improving payroll processes and operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to use AI, automation, payroll technology, and improved workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase turnaround times.

Must-have experience

  • Minimum 1â2 years of hands-on UK payroll processing experience.
  • Experience working in a bureau, outsourced payroll environment, or shared services centre is preferred.
  • Experience managing multiple client payroll accounts is an advantage.

  • Experience with payroll software such as BrightPay, Xero Payroll, or similar is an advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential financial information.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working with data and payroll-related reporting and metrics.
  • Practical experience or strong interest in using AI tools, automation, and IT applications to improve daily workflows.

Must-have attributes

Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for assigned payrolls and client accounts, follows through on tasks without constant supervision, and proactively resolves issues or roadblocks.

Humility: Open to feedback, willing to learn, and comfortable acknowledging knowledge gaps and seeking support when required.

Structured Thinking: Able to organise multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and tasks in a clear and logical manner, while using sound judgement to prioritise competing requirements.

Data Driven & Attention to Detail: Comfortable working with numbers and payroll data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Able to identify discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies before they impact payroll processing or clients.

Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way: Able to communicate clearly and professionally when dealing with sensitive payroll issues, missing information, delays, or difficult client situations while maintaining a constructive client relationship.

AI & Tech Savvy: Energetic about adopting new software, AI tools, automation, and technology to make payroll processes more efficient and effective.

Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.

Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

Technical Round: A 30-minute interview and practical assessment with the Hiring Team to assess UK payroll knowledge, payroll processing experience, attention to detail, ability to work with payroll data, and understanding of UK payroll processes and deadlines.

Soft Skills Round: A 30-minute chat with a member of the leadership team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values, including ownership, humility, structured thinking, communication, and ability to handle challenging situations.

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
Job Title: HR Operations SpecialistÂ 

Type: Independent ContractorÂ 

Location: Remote | South Africa

About Us

The Law Offices of Sabrina Li, P.C. is a leading, full-service U.S. immigration law firm with offices in Los Angeles, Pasadena, Santa Ana, and Dallas, as well as international operations across Asia, Africa, and Central and South America. We are dedicated to helping individuals, families, and businesses navigate complex legal challenges with skill, compassion, and integrity.

We are proud to be recognized as a 2025 Inc. Best Workplaces honoree, a distinction that reflects our intentional investment in our people and workplace culture. Our firm prioritizes professional development, clear career pathways, and a culture of accountability and respectâcreating a workplace where high performers can build meaningful, long-term careers.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a tech-savvy, proactive HR professional with excellent communication skills to support our HR team across recruitment, onboarding, compliance, and training. You'll work alongside firm leadership to keep day-to-day HR operations running smoothly and help identify smarter, more efficient ways to manage HR processes using AI and automation.

If you enjoy variety in your work, thrive on process and organization, adapt quickly to new tools, and want to grow with a firm that invests in its people, this role is a great fit.

Key Responsibilities

HR Operations & Compliance

  • Support the employee onboarding process, helping new hires get set up and proficient with the firm's technology stack within their first week.
  • Assist with HR document, process, and compliance audits, and monitor completion of required documentation, certifications, training, and policy acknowledgements.
  • Follow up with employees and managers on outstanding compliance items.
  • Maintain accurate HR records within Rippling and other HR systems.

Recruitment & Talent Support

  • Support sourcing for open roles, including candidate outreach and headhunting for hard-to-fill positions when standard applicant pipelines fall short.
  • Help manage candidate pipelines and keep hiring managers updated on status.
  • Assist with background and reference checks and credential verification.
  • Participate in candidate interviews alongside hiring managers.

Training & Development

  • Help maintain and update the firm's training curriculum, onboarding materials, and learning resources.
  • Assist in creating SOPs, workflow documentation, process maps, and training materials as needed.
  • Support the development of assessments and knowledge checks to track training completion.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to streamline HR workflows through automation and AI-powered tools.
  • Help maintain workflows within monday.com and other operational platforms.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field (required).

jobs.title: Remote Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.
